A Trip can have several Recaps.\n_Avoid_: Post, blog, article\n\n**Byline**:\nThe Contributor's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required.\n_Avoid_: Author (the Admin who typed it in is not the author)"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01E2rM5ofDkpVZcF8ZVBEPb1","name":"Edit","input":{"file_path":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/CONTEXT.md","old_string":"_Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push","new_string":"_Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push\n\n**Backup**:\nA dated archive of the database and uploaded Images, kept somewhere private outside the repository. It is the only copy of Drafts and Recap sources if the console laptop is lost.\n\n## Operations\n\n**Console laptop**:\nThe single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Both Admins work on it.\n\n**Handover**:\nThe yearly transfer to new officers: outgoing Admins create the incoming Admins' accounts, incoming Admins remove the outgoing ones, and the Console laptop or latest Backup moves with them. {"parentUuid":"6e292e5d-d2af-4e60-953c-e01083efdaa4","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMC1J9pXH85BYsBFXipj","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I recorded everything:\n- `CONTEXT.md` gained four terms. **Byline** is the Contributor's name plus class year, both required, with *Author* listed under Avoid. **Backup**, **Console laptop**, and **Handover** are the other three.\n- I added `docs/adr/ADR-003-admins-only-no-editor-accounts.md`. It cites the brief's editor clauses and gives your reason for dropping editor accounts.\n\nYou didn't answer **Q6**, so it carries over. Round 4 should be the last one:\n\n---\n\n❓ **Q1 - Deleting a Trip that has Recaps** (carried over). If an Admin deletes \"Chicago 2026\" while it still has Recaps:\n\n➡️ The system **refuses**. The Admin has to move or delete those Recaps first.\n\n---\n\n❓ **Q2 - Placing Images while writing.** An Admin pastes in a Contributor's text and adds photos. How do Images end up in the right spot?\n\n➡️ After an Admin uploads an Image to a Recap, the edit page shows a ready-made Markdown snippet with the alt text filled in, such as `![Team at the Chicago skyline](images/abc123.jpg)`, which they paste where they want it. A **Preview** button renders the sanitized result on a reload. Per ADR-002, there's no live preview and no drag-and-drop.\n\n---\n\n❓ **Q3 - Trips with nothing to show yet.** A Trip is created before anyone sends in a Recap, or all its Recaps are still Drafts. Should that Trip appear on the public site?\n\n➡️ **No.** A Trip appears only once it has at least one Published Recap, so readers never land on an empty page. Within a Trip page, Recaps are listed in the order they were Published.\n\n---\n\n❓ **Q4 - Unpublishing something already live.** An Admin Unpublishes a Recap that is already on the public site. It stays visible until the next Deploy. Is that acceptable, or should Unpublish warn the Admin that they also need to Deploy?\n\n➡️ Show a warning: \"This Recap is still live until you Deploy.\" The same applies to edits of Published Recaps. In both cases this is just a visible reminder, not an automatic Deploy.\n\n---\n\nIf you agree with these, the frontier is empty. A Trip carries its own required Summary of what the trip was, and groups the Recaps written about it.","originalFile":"# Kenyon Model UN Recaps\n\nA content system where the Kenyon Model UN club's officers publish recaps of the club's conference trips for the Kenyon community.\n\n## Content\n\n**Trip**:\nOne conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Trip groups the Recaps written about it.\n_Avoid_: Event, conference (as the record's name)\n\n**Recap**:\nA Contributor's written account of exactly one Trip, with text and optional photos. A Trip can have several Recaps.\n_Avoid_: Post, blog, article\n\n**Byline**:\nThe Contributor's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required.\n_Avoid_: Author (the Admin who typed it in is not the author)\n\n**Image**:\nA photo uploaded into the system and placed inline in a Recap's body, always with alt text. Recaps show only uploaded Images, never ones hosted elsewhere.\n_Avoid_: Media, attachment, embed\n\n## Publishing\n\n**Draft**:\nA Recap's status while it is not yet meant for readers. Drafts never leave the database.\n\n**Published**:\nA Recap's status once it is approved for the public site. A Published Recap is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\n\n**Publish / Unpublish**:\nMoving a Recap from Draft to Published, or back.\n_Avoid_: using \"publish\" for rebuilding the site\n\n**Deploy**:\nRebuilding the public site from every Published Recap and pushing it live. Only Admins deploy. The assignment names the command `cms publish`. That command performs a Deploy, despite its name.\n_Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push\n\n**Backup**:\nA dated archive of the database and uploaded Images, kept somewhere private outside the repository. It is the only copy of Drafts and Recap sources if the console laptop is lost.\n\n## Operations\n\n**Console laptop**:\nThe single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Both Admins work on it.\n\n**Handover**:\nThe yearly transfer to new officers: outgoing Admins create the incoming Admins' accounts, incoming Admins remove the outgoing ones, and the Console laptop or latest Backup moves with them. The last Admin can never be removed.\n\n## People\n\n**Admin**:\nThe club's President or Vice President, and the only people with a login. Admins enter Recaps on Contributors' behalf, manage Trips, and Deploy.\n_Avoid_: Officer (in the system), superuser\n\n**Contributor**:\nA club member who writes a Recap and sends it to an Admin to enter. A Contributor has no login.\n_Avoid_: Editor, author, writer, member (for this role)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":5,"oldLines":7,"newStart":5,"newLines":7,"lines":[" ## Content"," "," **Trip**:","-One conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Trip groups the Recaps written about it.","+One conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Trip carries its own required Summary of what the trip was, and groups the Recaps written about it."," _Avoid_: Event, conference (as the record's name)"," "," **Recap**:"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"073cac1e-d7b7-4298-a0a0-8b335242f688","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3c83bfcc-3eab-41bd-893a-8b0e0abb030e","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

Readers see it at the top of the Trip's page.\n_Avoid_: Description, intro\n\n**Recap**:","originalFile":"# Kenyon Model UN Recaps\n\nA content system where the Kenyon Model UN club's officers publish recaps of the club's conference trips for the Kenyon community.\n\n## Content\n\n**Trip**:\nOne conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Trip carries its own required Summary of what the trip was, and groups the Recaps written about it.\n_Avoid_: Event, conference (as the record's name)\n\n**Recap**:\nOne Contributor's personal account of exactly one Trip, with text and optional photos. Recaps are individual anecdotes, while the Trip's Summary says what the trip was. A Trip can have several Recaps.\n_Avoid_: Post, blog, article\n\n**Byline**:\nThe Contributor's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required.\n_Avoid_: Author (the Admin who typed it in is not the author)\n\n**Image**:\nA photo uploaded into the system and placed inline in a Recap's body, always with alt text. Recaps show only uploaded Images, never ones hosted elsewhere.\n_Avoid_: Media, attachment, embed\n\n## Publishing\n\n**Draft**:\nA Recap's status while it is not yet meant for readers. Drafts never leave the database.\n\n**Published**:\nA Recap's status once it is approved for the public site. A Published Recap is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\n\n**Publish / Unpublish**:\nMoving a Recap from Draft to Published, or back.\n_Avoid_: using \"publish\" for rebuilding the site\n\n**Deploy**:\nRebuilding the public site from every Published Recap and pushing it live. Only Admins deploy. The assignment names the command `cms publish`. That command performs a Deploy, despite its name.\n_Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push\n\n**Backup**:\nA dated archive of the database and uploaded Images, kept somewhere private outside the repository. It is the only copy of Drafts and Recap sources if the console laptop is lost.\n\n## Operations\n\n**Console laptop**:\nThe single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Both Admins work on it.\n\n**Handover**:\nThe yearly transfer to new officers: outgoing Admins create the incoming Admins' accounts, incoming Admins remove the outgoing ones, and the Console laptop or latest Backup moves with them. The last Admin can never be removed.\n\n## People\n\n**Admin**:\nThe club's President or Vice President, and the only people with a login. Admins enter Recaps on Contributors' behalf, manage Trips, and Deploy.\n_Avoid_: Officer (in the system), superuser\n\n**Contributor**:\nA club member who writes a Recap and sends it to an Admin to enter. A Contributor has no login.\n_Avoid_: Editor, author, writer, member (for this role)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":8,"oldLines":6,"newStart":8,"newLines":10,"lines":[" One conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. Comments are a known gap.\n\n**Getting content live**\n- **Draft → Published**: Admins Publish and Unpublish Recaps.\n- **Deploy**: an Admin rebuilds and pushes the public site. The command stays named `cms publish` because the assignment requires it, and the glossary notes the mismatch.\n- If an Admin edits or Unpublishes a Recap that's already live, they see the warning \"still live until you Deploy.\"\n- Readers see a home page of Trips, newest first. Each Trip page shows its Summary and then its Recaps in the order they were Published. A Trip only appears once it has at least one Published Recap. Pages use relative paths of the form `trips/2026-chicago/<recap>/`.\n\n**Keeping the content safe**\n- **Backup**: a `cms backup` command builds a dated archive of the database and Images, which goes somewhere private and never into git.\n- **Handover**: each year, outgoing Admins create the new Admins' accounts and the new Admins remove the old ones. {"parentUuid":"287fac4b-ef1a-4506-92c6-9e2723cab41b","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"6f70addb-9d93-4e90-9201-c772df372f59","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_017YGDNsBbxmEanXzXDUmPZW","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t# Kenyon Model UN Recaps\n2\t\n3\tA content system where the Kenyon Model UN club's officers publish recaps of the club's conference trips for the Kenyon community.\n4\t\n5\t## Content\n6\t\n7\t**Trip**:\n8\tOne conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Trip carries its own required Summary of what the trip was, and groups the Recaps written about it.\n9\t_Avoid_: Event, conference (as the record's name)\n10\t\n11\t**Summary**:\n12\tAn Admin-written overview on a Trip: the conference, where it was, and what happened overall. Readers see it at the top of the Trip's page.\n13\t_Avoid_: Description, intro\n14\t\n15\t**Recap**:\n16\tOne Contributor's personal account of exactly one Trip, with text and optional photos. Recaps are individual anecdotes, while the Trip's Summary says what the trip was. A Trip can have several Recaps.\n17\t_Avoid_: Post, blog, article\n18\t\n19\t**Byline**:\n20\tThe Contributor's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required.\n21\t_Avoid_: Author (the Admin who typed it in is not the author)\n22\t\n23\t**Image**:\n24\tA photo uploaded into the system and placed inline in a Recap's body, always with alt text. Recaps show only uploaded Images, never ones hosted elsewhere.\n25\t_Avoid_: Media, attachment, embed\n26\t\n27\t## Publishing\n28\t\n29\t**Draft**:\n30\tA Recap's status while it is not yet meant for readers. Drafts never leave the database.\n31\t\n32\t**Published**:\n33\tA Recap's status once it is approved for the public site. A Published Recap is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\n34\t\n35\t**Publish / Unpublish**:\n36\tMoving a Recap from Draft to Published, or back.\n37\t_Avoid_: using \"publish\" for rebuilding the site\n38\t\n39\t**Deploy**:\n40\tRebuilding the public site from every Published Recap and pushing it live. Only Admins deploy. The assignment names the command `cms publish`. That command performs a Deploy, despite its name.\n41\t_Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push\n42\t\n43\t**Backup**:\n44\tA dated archive of the database and uploaded Images, kept somewhere private outside the repository. It is the only copy of Drafts and Recap sources if the console laptop is lost.\n45\t\n46\t## Operations\n47\t\n48\t**Console laptop**:\n49\tThe single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Both Admins work on it.\n50\t\n51\t**Handover**:\n52\tThe yearly transfer to new officers: outgoing Admins create the incoming Admins' accounts, incoming Admins remove the outgoing ones, and the Console laptop or latest Backup moves with them. The last Admin can never be removed.\n53\t\n54\t## People\n55\t\n56\t**Admin**:\n57\tThe club's President or Vice President, and the only people with a login. Admins enter Recaps on Contributors' behalf, manage Trips, and Deploy.\n58\t_Avoid_: Officer (in the system), superuser\n59\t\n60\t**Contributor**:\n61\tA club member who writes a Recap and sends it to an Admin to enter. A Contributor has no login.\n62\t_Avoid_: Editor, author, writer, member (for this role)\n63\t"}]},"uuid":"f542eef4-1fd6-42ac-83fe-1634bf30ff5f","timestamp":"2026-10-24T14:14:21.337Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/CONTEXT.md","content":"# Kenyon Model UN Recaps\n\nA content system where the Kenyon Model UN club's officers publish recaps of the club's conference trips for the Kenyon community.\n\n## Content\n\n**Trip**:\nOne conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Trip carries its own required Summary of what the trip was, and groups the Recaps written about it.\n_Avoid_: Event, conference (as the record's name)\n\n**Summary**:\nAn Admin-written overview on a Trip: the conference, where it was, and what happened overall. Readers see it at the top of the Trip's page.\n_Avoid_: Description, intro\n\n**Recap**:\nOne Contributor's personal account of exactly one Trip, with text and optional photos. Recaps are individual anecdotes, while the Trip's Summary says what the trip was. A Trip can have several Recaps.\n_Avoid_: Post, blog, article\n\n**Byline**:\nThe Contributor's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required.\n_Avoid_: Author (the Admin who typed it in is not the author)\n\n**Image**:\nA photo uploaded into the system and placed inline in a Recap's body, always with alt text. Recaps show only uploaded Images, never ones hosted elsewhere.\n_Avoid_: Media, attachment, embed\n\n## Publishing\n\n**Draft**:\nA Recap's status while it is not yet meant for readers. Drafts never leave the database.\n\n**Published**:\nA Recap's status once it is approved for the public site. A Published Recap is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\n\n**Publish / Unpublish**:\nMoving a Recap from Draft to Published, or back.\n_Avoid_: using \"publish\" for rebuilding the site\n\n**Deploy**:\nRebuilding the public site from every Published Recap and pushing it live. Only Admins deploy. The assignment names the command `cms publish`. That command performs a Deploy, despite its name.\n_Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push\n\n**Backup**:\nA dated archive of the database and uploaded Images, kept somewhere private outside the repository. It is the only copy of Drafts and Recap sources if the console laptop is lost.\n\n## Operations\n\n**Console laptop**:\nThe single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Both Admins work on it.\n\n**Handover**:\nThe yearly transfer to new officers: outgoing Admins create the incoming Admins' accounts, incoming Admins remove the outgoing ones, and the Console laptop or latest Backup moves with them. The last Admin can never be removed.\n\n## People\n\n**Admin**:\nThe club's President or Vice President, and the only people with a login. Admins enter Recaps on Contributors' behalf, manage Trips, and Deploy.\n_Avoid_: Officer (in the system), superuser\n\n**Contributor**:\nA club member who writes a Recap and sends it to an Admin to enter. A Contributor has no login.\n_Avoid_: Editor, author, writer, member (for this role)\n","numLines":63,"startLine":1,"totalLines":63}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"287fac4b-ef1a-4506-92c6-9e2723cab41b","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3c83bfcc-3eab-41bd-893a-8b0e0abb030e","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

Both parts are required.\n_Avoid_: Author (an Admin who typed a Recap in is not its writer)","originalFile":"# Kenyon Model UN Recaps\n\nA content system where the Kenyon Model UN club's officers publish recaps of the club's conference trips for the Kenyon community.\n\n## Content\n\n**Trip**:\nOne conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Trip carries its own required Summary of what the trip was, and groups the Recaps written about it.\n_Avoid_: Event, conference (as the record's name)\n\n**Summary**:\nAn Admin-written overview on a Trip: the conference, where it was, and what happened overall. Readers see it at the top of the Trip's page.\n_Avoid_: Description, intro\n\n**Recap**:\nOne Contributor's personal account of exactly one Trip, with text and optional photos. Recaps are individual anecdotes, while the Trip's Summary says what the trip was. A Trip can have several Recaps.\n_Avoid_: Post, blog, article\n\n**Byline**:\nThe Contributor's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required.\n_Avoid_: Author (the Admin who typed it in is not the author)\n\n**Image**:\nA photo uploaded into the system and placed inline in a Recap's body, always with alt text. Recaps show only uploaded Images, never ones hosted elsewhere.\n_Avoid_: Media, attachment, embed\n\n## Publishing\n\n**Draft**:\nA Recap's status while it is not yet meant for readers. Drafts never leave the database.\n\n**Published**:\nA Recap's status once it is approved for the public site. A Published Recap is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\n\n**Publish / Unpublish**:\nMoving a Recap from Draft to Published, or back.\n_Avoid_: using \"publish\" for rebuilding the site\n\n**Deploy**:\nRebuilding the public site from every Published Recap and pushing it live. Only Admins deploy. The assignment names the command `cms publish`. That command performs a Deploy, despite its name.\n_Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push\n\n**Backup**:\nA dated archive of the database and uploaded Images, kept somewhere private outside the repository. It is the only copy of Drafts and Recap sources if the console laptop is lost.\n\n## Operations\n\n**Console laptop**:\nThe single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Both Admins work on it.\n\n**Handover**:\nThe yearly transfer to new officers: outgoing Admins create the incoming Admins' accounts, incoming Admins remove the outgoing ones, and the Console laptop or latest Backup moves with them. The last Admin can never be removed.\n\n## People\n\n**Admin**:\nThe club's President or Vice President, and the only people with a login. Admins enter Recaps on Contributors' behalf, manage Trips, and Deploy.\n_Avoid_: Officer (in the system), superuser\n\n**Contributor**:\nA club member who writes a Recap and sends it to an Admin to enter. A Contributor has no login.\n_Avoid_: Editor, author, writer, member (for this role)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":13,"oldLines":12,"newStart":13,"newLines":12,"lines":[" _Avoid_: Description, intro"," "," **Recap**:","-One Contributor's personal account of exactly one Trip, with text and optional photos. Admins and Editors all log in on it.","originalFile":"# Kenyon Model UN Recaps\n\nA content system where the Kenyon Model UN club's officers publish recaps of the club's conference trips for the Kenyon community.\n\n## Content\n\n**Trip**:\nOne conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Trip carries its own required Summary of what the trip was, and groups the Recaps written about it.\n_Avoid_: Event, conference (as the record's name)\n\n**Summary**:\nAn Admin-written overview on a Trip: the conference, where it was, and what happened overall. Readers see it at the top of the Trip's page.\n_Avoid_: Description, intro\n\n**Recap**:\nOne club member's personal account of exactly one Trip, with text and optional photos. It is written by an Editor, or entered by an Admin for a Contributor. Recaps are individual anecdotes, while the Trip's Summary says what the trip was. A Trip can have several Recaps.\n_Avoid_: Post, blog, article\n\n**Byline**:\nThe writer's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required.\n_Avoid_: Author (an Admin who typed a Recap in is not its writer)\n\n**Image**:\nA photo uploaded into the system and placed inline in a Recap's body, always with alt text. Recaps show only uploaded Images, never ones hosted elsewhere.\n_Avoid_: Media, attachment, embed\n\n## Publishing\n\n**Draft**:\nA Recap's status while it is not yet meant for readers. Every Recap starts as a Draft, and Drafts never leave the database.\n\n**Published**:\nA Recap's status once an Admin has approved it for the public site. A Published Recap is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\n\n**Publish / Unpublish**:\nMoving a Recap from Draft to Published, or back. Only Admins Publish or Unpublish.\n_Avoid_: using \"publish\" for rebuilding the site\n\n**Deploy**:\nRebuilding the public site from every Published Recap and pushing it live. Only Admins deploy. The assignment names the command `cms publish`. That command performs a Deploy, despite its name.\n_Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push\n\n**Backup**:\nA dated archive of the database and uploaded Images, kept somewhere private outside the repository. It is the only copy of Drafts and Recap sources if the console laptop is lost.\n\n## Operations\n\n**Console laptop**:\nThe single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Both Admins work on it.\n\n**Handover**:\nThe yearly transfer to new officers: outgoing Admins create the incoming Admins' accounts, incoming Admins remove the outgoing ones, and the Console laptop or latest Backup moves with them. The last Admin can never be removed.\n\n## People\n\n**Admin**:\nThe club's President or Vice President, and the only people with a login. Admins enter Recaps on Contributors' behalf, manage Trips, and Deploy.\n_Avoid_: Officer (in the system), superuser\n\n**Contributor**:\nA club member who writes a Recap and sends it to an Admin to enter. A Contributor has no login.\n_Avoid_: Editor, author, writer, member (for this role)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":41,"oldLines":12,"newStart":41,"newLines":12,"lines":[" _Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push"," "," **Backup**:","-A dated archive of the database and uploaded Images, kept somewhere private outside the repository. {"parentUuid":"e20dd47f-27d5-46c8-ab0a-4bd54ea7022e","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"deferred_tools_record","entries":[],"toolInputCopies":[{"id":"toolu_01CEiex31bU3xBohGf68VzVb","copy":"wire"},{"id":"toolu_01K9bRab6qVy8JrJMBwh4TNU","copy":"wire"},{"id":"toolu_01UtejS41rELQWvXMALVaMnH","copy":"wire"},{"id":"toolu_013XtcJv94yu9bdeTWg1hjTo","copy":"wire"},{"id":"toolu_01GJZcxVPXvSZ2JYvNv7P8kn","copy":"wire"}]},"type":"attachment","uuid":"04e6a28a-8e40-4739-9e0c-71a5a8a87016","timestamp":"2026-10-24T14:14:45.616Z","session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3c83bfcc-3eab-41bd-893a-8b0e0abb030e","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}
{"parentUuid":"04e6a28a-8e40-4739-9e0c-71a5a8a87016","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMCfDMugRH5eD529HgLw","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01TyYfSDpKBh8qFXdViCbYfZ","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/docs/adr/ADR-003-editors-draft-admins-publish.md","content":"# ADR-003: Editors write Drafts; only Admins Publish\n\n**Status:** accepted\n**Date:** 2026-10-24\n\n## Context\n\nThe assignment requires two roles, Admin and Editor, with different\npermissions. The client brief says editors \"can publish their own posts\", but\nthe club's officers also want to edit every Recap before it reaches the public\nsite. An earlier draft of this decision removed Editor accounts entirely\nbecause, under ADR-001, Editors can only log in on the Console laptop. That\nversion was withdrawn because it fails the two-role requirement.\n\n## Decision\n\nEditor accounts exist. An Editor can log in, create and edit their own Recaps\nas Drafts, and add Images to them. An Editor cannot Publish, create Trips,\nmanage accounts, Deploy, make Backups, or edit another person's Recap.\n\nAdmins (the President and Vice President) do all of that. They are the only\nones who Publish. They can also enter a Recap on behalf of a member who has no\naccount.\n\n## Why Publish stays admin-only\n\nThe officers want to review and edit every Recap before readers see it, and\nonly Admins Deploy anyway. Letting Editors Publish would add no speed, because\nnothing is public until an Admin Deploys. It would only blur which Recaps an\nAdmin has actually checked. Keeping Publish with Admins makes Published mean\nexactly one thing: an Admin has approved this Recap.\n\n## Consequences\n\n- This departs from the brief's \"editors can publish their own posts\". It\n  matches WordPress's Contributor role more than its Editor role.\n- Editors still need to come to the Console laptop to write. Members who won't\n  can send their text to an Admin, who enters it with their Byline.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2207,"cache_read_input_tokens":75332,"output_tokens":675,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2207,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":675,"cache_read_input_tokens":75332,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2207,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2207},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01TyYfSDpKBh8qFXdViCbYfZ":{"file_path":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/docs/adr/ADR-003-editors-draft-admins-publish.md","content":"# ADR-003: Editors write Drafts; only Admins Publish\n\n**Status:** accepted\n**Date:** 2026-10-24\n\n## Context\n\nThe assignment requires two roles, Admin and Editor, with different\npermissions. They are the only\nones who Publish. They can also enter a Recap on behalf of a member who has no\naccount.\n\n## Why Publish stays admin-only\n\nThe officers want to review and edit every Recap before readers see it, and\nonly Admins Deploy anyway. {"parentUuid":"33be1913-f816-4888-b90a-87e243effe29","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"6f70addb-9d93-4e90-9201-c772df372f59","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01TyYfSDpKBh8qFXdViCbYfZ","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/docs/adr/ADR-003-editors-draft-admins-publish.md (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"ce65dffa-e90f-42cb-a591-a6992dd2d69e","timestamp":"2026-10-24T14:14:45.803Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"create","filePath":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/docs/adr/ADR-003-editors-draft-admins-publish.md","content":"# ADR-003: Editors write Drafts; only Admins Publish\n\n**Status:** accepted\n**Date:** 2026-10-24\n\n## Context\n\nThe assignment requires two roles, Admin and Editor, with different\npermissions. The client brief says editors \"can publish their own posts\", but\nthe club's officers also want to edit every Recap before it reaches the public\nsite. An earlier draft of this decision removed Editor accounts entirely\nbecause, under ADR-001, Editors can only log in on the Console laptop. That\nversion was withdrawn because it fails the two-role requirement.\n\n## Decision\n\nEditor accounts exist. An Editor can log in, create and edit their own Recaps\nas Drafts, and add Images to them. An Editor cannot Publish, create Trips,\nmanage accounts, Deploy, make Backups, or edit another person's Recap.\n\nAdmins (the President and Vice President) do all of that. They are the only\nones who Publish. They can also enter a Recap on behalf of a member who has no\naccount.\n\n## Why Publish stays admin-only\n\nThe officers want to review and edit every Recap before readers see it, and\nonly Admins Deploy anyway. Letting Editors Publish would add no speed, because\nnothing is public until an Admin Deploys. It would only blur which Recaps an\nAdmin has actually checked. Keeping Publish with Admins makes Published mean\nexactly one thing: an Admin has approved this Recap.\n\n## Consequences\n\n- This departs from the brief's \"editors can publish their own posts\". It\n  matches WordPress's Contributor role more than its Editor role.\n- Editors still need to come to the Console laptop to write. Members who won't\n  can send their text to an Admin, who enters it with their Byline.\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"33be1913-f816-4888-b90a-87e243effe29","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3c83bfcc-3eab-41bd-893a-8b0e0abb030e","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"83617be8-fd51-4ec0-b62d-fceaa9dc111d","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMCfhgF7jeLmterzpWm7","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've made both changes, and I haven't started the spec or committed anything.\n\n**`CONTEXT.md`**\n- **Editor** is back. An Editor logs in, writes their own Recaps as Drafts, and adds Images to them. They can't Publish, create Trips, manage accounts, Deploy, make Backups, or touch another person's Recap.\n- **Admin** now lists everything only Admins can do, including being the only ones who Publish, plus entering a Recap for a member who has no account.\n- **Contributor** stays, but it now means only a member *without* a login. \"Editor\" is listed under its Avoid.\n- **Recap**, **Byline**, **Draft**, **Publish/Unpublish**, **Backup** and **Console laptop** are reworded to fit. Every Recap now starts as a Draft, and Editors log in on the Console laptop too.\n\n**ADR-003**: I deleted the old, uncommitted ADR-003 and wrote `docs/adr/ADR-003-editors-draft-admins-publish.md` in its place. It says Editors exist because the assignment requires two roles. It keeps Publish admin-only so that \"Published\" always means an Admin approved it, and because nothing is public until an Admin Deploys anyway. It also notes this goes against the brief's \"editors can publish their own posts.\"\n\nBringing Editors back adds four open questions. These are new, so I'm asking them before we treat the design as settled:\n\n❓ **Q1 - How does an Editor say \"ready for review\"?** Right now an Admin can't tell a half-written Draft from a finished one. Should there be a **Submitted** status between Draft and Published (WordPress calls it `pending`)?\n➡️ Yes. The Editor marks the Draft as Submitted, and the Admin's list shows Submitted Recaps first.\n\n❓ **Q2 - Can an Editor change their Recap after it's Published?**\n➡️ No. Once it's Published, only Admins can edit it. If an Editor wants a change, they ask an Admin.\n\n❓ **Q3 - Can an Editor delete their own Recap?**\n➡️ Yes while it's a Draft or Submitted, no once it's Published.\n\n❓ **Q4 - Where does an Editor's Byline come from?**\n➡️ It's filled in from their account's name and class year, so Editors don't type it. Recaps that an Admin enters for a Contributor still get a Byline typed by hand.\n\nOnce you've answered, I'll update `CONTEXT.md` and give you the summary again to confirm."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":776,"cache_read_input_tokens":77539,"output_tokens":860,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":27},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":776,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":860,"cache_read_input_tokens":77539,"cache_creation_input_tokens":776,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":776},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"396f691a-fd74-46ab-b966-c578a8775ba8","apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011CgMCfhNdZbR1BRFQjW4mU","requestRef":"8aa95e9f-41b6-42ab-a4a9-9fac58203d3f","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","type":"assistant","uuid":"aeb24e67-4032-45b5-b005-bd688ee61a48","timestamp":"2026-10-24T14:14:54.675Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3c83bfcc-3eab-41bd-893a-8b0e0abb030e","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

Admins can edit any Recap and can still enter a Recap on a member's behalf if someone emails it.\n\nHow members get to the laptop: the admin console still runs on the President's laptop. Club members get their own Editor accounts, and they log in on the President's laptop during the Sunday club meetings. That solves the problem of members having to track an officer down across campus, because the laptop is already in the room every week. Members who miss a meeting can send their writing to an Admin, who enters it for them. Admins create the Editor accounts, and the President and VP decide which members get one.\n\nPlease do the following:\n1. Update CONTEXT.md so Editor is a real role with accounts, and Contributor is only used for a member whose writing an Admin enters for them.\n2. Replace ADR-003 with a new ADR-003 that records this decision: Editors exist, Publish is Admin-only, Editors use the console on the President's laptop at the Sunday meetings, and remote editing would need hosting and is out of scope. Delete the old ADR-003 file.\n3. Keep everything else we already settled (Trips with required Summary, Recaps with Byline, uploaded Images with required alt text, the Instagram footer link, Publish and Deploy flow, cms backup, yearly handover).\n4. Show me the changed parts of CONTEXT.md and the new ADR. Do not commit yet and do not move to the spec.\n</pasted_content id=\"0185\">\n"},"uuid":"4225f5ee-ba44-464f-83a0-90bbe02c06d8","timestamp":"2026-10-24T14:17:14.521Z","permissionMode":"auto","origin":{"kind":"human"},"promptSource":"typed","turnOrigin":"human","turnPosition":{"promptIndex":7,"turnIndex":7},"userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3c83bfcc-3eab-41bd-893a-8b0e0abb030e","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"6df0496c-29ba-432a-b751-65af85f473e5","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMCrgJx3LkzeQmpm2wjA","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01LKxeaGUS4R3ReVi1htZbfb","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/docs/adr/ADR-003-editors-at-sunday-meetings.md","content":"# ADR-003: Editors write at the Sunday meetings; only Admins Publish\n\n**Status:** accepted\n**Date:** 2026-10-24\n\n## Context\n\nThe assignment requires two roles, Admin and Editor, with different\npermissions. ADR-001 keeps the admin console on one local machine, the\nPresident's laptop, which never goes on the internet. So an Editor account is\nonly useful if members can get to that laptop. The officers also want to\nreview and edit every Recap before readers see it.\n\n## Decision\n\n- **Editors exist.** Members the President and VP choose get an Editor\n  account, created by an Admin. An Editor writes and edits their own Recaps\n  as Drafts and adds Images with alt text. They cannot Publish or Unpublish,\n  create Trips, manage accounts, Deploy, make Backups, or edit another\n  person's Recap.\n- **Publish is Admin-only.** Admins (President and VP) can do everything an\n  Editor can, plus all of the above, and can edit any Recap.\n- **Editors write at the Sunday club meetings.** The President brings the\n  Console laptop, so members don't have to track an officer down across\n  campus. A member who misses a meeting can email their writing to an Admin,\n  who enters it for them as a Contributor.\n\n## Why Publish stays Admin-only\n\nNothing is public until an Admin Deploys, so letting Editors Publish would\nnot make anything go live sooner. It would only blur which Recaps an Admin has\nactually checked. With Publish kept for Admins, Published means exactly one\nthing: an Admin approved this Recap.\n\n## Considered and rejected\n\n- **No Editor accounts, with Admins entering everything.** Simpler, but it\n  fails the assignment's two-role requirement.\n- **Remote editing, so Editors log in from their own laptops.** This needs the\n  console hosted on the internet, with the security work ADR-001 avoids. Out\n  of scope.\n\n## Consequences\n\n- This departs from the brief's \"editors can publish their own posts\". The\n  Editor role here matches WordPress's Contributor role more than its Editor\n  role.\n- Writing happens on a weekly rhythm. A Recap written between meetings waits\n  for Sunday, or goes through an Admin.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1519,"cache_read_input_tokens":78315,"output_tokens":2287,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":419},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1519,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2287,"cache_read_input_tokens":78315,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1519,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1519},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01LKxeaGUS4R3ReVi1htZbfb":{"file_path":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/docs/adr/ADR-003-editors-at-sunday-meetings.md","content":"# ADR-003: Editors write at the Sunday meetings; only Admins Publish\n\n**Status:** accepted\n**Date:** 2026-10-24\n\n## Context\n\nThe assignment requires two roles, Admin and Editor, with different\npermissions. A member who misses a meeting can email their writing to an Admin,\n  who enters it for them as a Contributor.\n\n## Why Publish stays Admin-only\n\nNothing is public until an Admin Deploys, so letting Editors Publish would\nnot make anything go live sooner. Admins and Editors all log in on it.","newString":"The single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Admins work on it, and Editors log in on it during the Sunday club meetings.","originalFile":"# Kenyon Model UN Recaps\n\nA content system where the Kenyon Model UN club's officers publish recaps of the club's conference trips for the Kenyon community.\n\n## Content\n\n**Trip**:\nOne conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Trip carries its own required Summary of what the trip was, and groups the Recaps written about it.\n_Avoid_: Event, conference (as the record's name)\n\n**Summary**:\nAn Admin-written overview on a Trip: the conference, where it was, and what happened overall. Readers see it at the top of the Trip's page.\n_Avoid_: Description, intro\n\n**Recap**:\nOne club member's personal account of exactly one Trip, with text and optional photos. It is written by an Editor, or entered by an Admin for a Contributor. Recaps are individual anecdotes, while the Trip's Summary says what the trip was. A Trip can have several Recaps.\n_Avoid_: Post, blog, article\n\n**Byline**:\nThe writer's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required.\n_Avoid_: Author (an Admin who typed a Recap in is not its writer)\n\n**Image**:\nA photo uploaded into the system and placed inline in a Recap's body, always with alt text. Recaps show only uploaded Images, never ones hosted elsewhere.\n_Avoid_: Media, attachment, embed\n\n## Publishing\n\n**Draft**:\nA Recap's status while it is not yet meant for readers. Every Recap starts as a Draft, and Drafts never leave the database.\n\n**Published**:\nA Recap's status once an Admin has approved it for the public site. A Published Recap is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\n\n**Publish / Unpublish**:\nMoving a Recap from Draft to Published, or back. Only Admins Publish or Unpublish.\n_Avoid_: using \"publish\" for rebuilding the site\n\n**Deploy**:\nRebuilding the public site from every Published Recap and pushing it live. Only Admins deploy. The assignment names the command `cms publish`. That command performs a Deploy, despite its name.\n_Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push\n\n**Backup**:\nA dated archive of the database and uploaded Images, kept somewhere private outside the repository. It is the only copy of Drafts and Recap sources if the Console laptop is lost. Only Admins make Backups.\n\n## Operations\n\n**Console laptop**:\nThe single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Admins and Editors all log in on it.\n\n**Handover**:\nThe yearly transfer to new officers: outgoing Admins create the incoming Admins' accounts, incoming Admins remove the outgoing ones, and the Console laptop or latest Backup moves with them. The last Admin can never be removed.\n\n## People\n\n**Admin**:\nThe club's President or Vice President. Admins manage accounts and Trips, edit any Recap, Publish, Deploy, make Backups, and can enter a Recap on a Contributor's behalf.\n_Avoid_: Officer (in the system), superuser\n\n**Editor**:\nA club member with a login who writes their own Recaps as Drafts and adds Images to them. An Editor cannot touch another person's Recap, Publish, create Trips, manage accounts, Deploy, or make Backups.\n_Avoid_: Author, writer, contributor (for this role)\n\n**Contributor**:\nA club member without a login who sends a Recap to an Admin to enter.\n_Avoid_: Editor (for this role), author, writer\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":46,"oldLines":7,"newStart":46,"newLines":7,"lines":[" ## Operations"," "," **Console laptop**:","-The single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Admins and Editors all log in on it.","+The single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. The last Admin can never be removed."]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"e1b9041c-59de-42b5-bfdc-b788aa4e7f73","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3c83bfcc-3eab-41bd-893a-8b0e0abb030e","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

ADR-001 keeps the admin console on one local machine, the\nPresident's laptop, which never goes on the internet. So an Editor account is\nonly useful if members can get to that laptop. The officers also want to\nreview and edit every Recap before readers see it.\n\n## Decision\n\n- **Editors exist.** Members the President and VP choose get an Editor\n  account, created by an Admin. An Editor writes and edits their own Recaps\n  as Drafts and adds Images with alt text. They cannot Publish or Unpublish,\n  create Trips, manage accounts, Deploy, make Backups, or edit another\n  person's Recap.\n- **Publish is Admin-only.** Admins (President and VP) can do everything an\n  Editor can, plus all of the above, and can edit any Recap.\n- **Editors write at the Sunday club meetings.** The President brings the\n  Console laptop, so members don't have to track an officer down across\n  campus. A member who misses a meeting can email their writing to an Admin,\n  who enters it for them as a Contributor.\n\n## Why Publish stays Admin-only\n\nNothing is public until an Admin Deploys, so letting Editors Publish would\nnot make anything go live sooner. It would only blur which Recaps an Admin has\nactually checked. With Publish kept for Admins, Published means exactly one\nthing: an Admin approved this Recap.\n\n## Considered and rejected\n\n- **No Editor accounts, with Admins entering everything.** Simpler, but it\n  fails the assignment's two-role requirement.\n- **Remote editing, so Editors log in from their own laptops.** This needs the\n  console hosted on the internet, with the security work ADR-001 avoids. Out\n  of scope.\n\n## Consequences\n\n- This departs from the brief's \"editors can publish their own posts\". The\n  Editor role here matches WordPress's Contributor role more than its Editor\n  role.\n- Writing happens on a weekly rhythm. A Recap written between meetings waits\n  for Sunday, or goes through an Admin.\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"5282103a-8eae-451d-a017-ef718f4fb768","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3c83bfcc-3eab-41bd-893a-8b0e0abb030e","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"a6d692d5-8c4a-4a9e-8b3a-c11c13e13c78","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMCtQfezyV2RTBn4CxMe","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've updated `CONTEXT.md` and replaced ADR-003. Nothing is committed and I haven't started the spec. There's now one ADR-003 file, `docs/adr/ADR-003-editors-at-sunday-meetings.md`, and both earlier versions are deleted (neither was ever committed). The Trip, Summary, Image, Deploy and Handover entries are unchanged.\n\n## Changed parts of `CONTEXT.md`\n\n**Recap**:\nOne club member's personal account of exactly one Trip, with text and optional photos. It is written by an Editor, or entered by an Admin for a Contributor. Recaps are individual anecdotes, while the Trip's Summary says what the trip was. A Trip can have several Recaps.\n_Avoid_: Post, blog, article\n\n**Byline**:\nThe writer's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required.\n_Avoid_: Author (an Admin who typed a Recap in is not its writer)\n\n**Draft**:\nA Recap's status while it is not yet meant for readers. Every Recap starts as a Draft, and Drafts never leave the database.\n\n**Published**:\nA Recap's status once an Admin has approved it for the public site. A Published Recap is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\n\n**Publish / Unpublish**:\nMoving a Recap from Draft to Published, or back. Only Admins Publish or Unpublish.\n\n**Backup**: (… existing text …) Only Admins make Backups.\n\n**Console laptop**:\nThe single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Admins work on it, and Editors log in on it during the Sunday club meetings.\n\n**Admin**:\nThe club's President or Vice President. Admins can do everything an Editor can, and also Publish and Unpublish, create Trips, manage accounts, Deploy, and make Backups. They can edit any Recap and enter one on a Contributor's behalf.\n_Avoid_: Officer (in the system), superuser\n\n**Editor**:\nA club member with their own account who writes their own Recaps as Drafts and adds Images, with alt text, to them. The President and VP decide which members become Editors, and an Admin creates the account. An Editor cannot Publish or Unpublish, create Trips, manage accounts, Deploy, make Backups, or edit another person's Recap.\n_Avoid_: Author, writer, contributor (for this role)\n\n**Contributor**:\nA member whose writing an Admin enters for them, for example because they missed a Sunday meeting and emailed it in. A Contributor has no account of their own.\n_Avoid_: Editor (for this role), author, writer\n\n## New `docs/adr/ADR-003-editors-at-sunday-meetings.md`\n\n> # ADR-003: Editors write at the Sunday meetings; only Admins Publish\n>\n> **Status:** accepted · **Date:** 2026-10-24\n>\n> **Context.** The assignment requires two roles, Admin and Editor, with different permissions. ADR-001 keeps the admin console on one local machine, the President's laptop, which never goes on the internet. So an Editor account is only useful if members can get to that laptop. The officers also want to review and edit every Recap before readers see it.\n>\n> **Decision.**\n> - **Editors exist.** Members the President and VP choose get an Editor account, created by an Admin. An Editor writes and edits their own Recaps as Drafts and adds Images with alt text. They cannot Publish or Unpublish, create Trips, manage accounts, Deploy, make Backups, or edit another person's Recap.\n> - **Publish is Admin-only.** Admins (President and VP) can do everything an Editor can, plus all of the above, and can edit any Recap.\n> - **Editors write at the Sunday club meetings.** The President brings the Console laptop, so members don't have to track an officer down across campus. A member who misses a meeting can email their writing to an Admin, who enters it for them as a Contributor.\n>\n> **Why Publish stays Admin-only.** Nothing is public until an Admin Deploys, so letting Editors Publish would not make anything go live sooner. It would only blur which Recaps an Admin has actually checked. With Publish kept for Admins, Published means exactly one thing: an Admin approved this Recap.\n>\n> **Considered and rejected.**\n> - *No Editor accounts, with Admins entering everything.* Simpler, but it fails the assignment's two-role requirement.\n> - *Remote editing, so Editors log in from their own laptops.* This needs the console hosted on the internet, with the security work ADR-001 avoids. Out of scope.\n>\n> **Consequences.**\n> - This departs from the brief's \"editors can publish their own posts\". The Editor role here matches WordPress's Contributor role more than its Editor role.\n> - Writing happens on a weekly rhythm. A Recap written between meetings waits for Sunday, or goes through an Admin.\n\nThe four Editor questions from my last message are still open: a Submitted status, editing after Publish, Editors deleting their own Recaps, and where an Editor's Byline comes from. Answer them whenever you're ready. After that I'll give you the final summary to confirm."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2668,"cache_read_input_tokens":79834,"output_tokens":1792,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":56},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2668,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1792,"cache_read_input_tokens":79834,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2668,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2668},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"9d222011-9249-4874-8516-e94c763c505f","apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011CgMCtQDP7Mynk4mugVsBX","requestRef":"78808610-19a5-4441-a910-168c3ab2997c","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","type":"assistant","uuid":"258e423e-37b8-4d78-94d9-bb717df9d0ba","timestamp":"2026-10-24T14:17:51.269Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3c83bfcc-3eab-41bd-893a-8b0e0abb030e","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"5704d59f-a6f9-4ef0-baf7-71b0febb22f0","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMCxyykGoy37UwSo2gX2","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Yes, these four are needed. They decide what an Editor can do with a Recap after writing it, and the spec can't define the Editor role without them. I've adjusted them for the Sunday-meeting setup:\n\n---\n\n❓ **Q1 - How does an Editor signal \"ready for review\"?** An Editor might start a Recap at one Sunday meeting and finish it the next. As things stand, an Admin can't tell an unfinished Draft from a finished one. Should there be a **Submitted** status between Draft and Published, like WordPress's `pending`?\n\n➡️ **Yes.** The Editor marks the Recap Submitted when it's done. The Admin's list shows Submitted Recaps first. An Admin who wants changes can send it back to Draft.\n\n---\n\n❓ **Q2 - Can an Editor change their Recap once it's Submitted or Published?**\n\n➡️ An Editor can't edit a Submitted Recap unless an Admin sends it back to Draft. Once it's Published, only Admins edit it, and an Editor who spots a typo tells an Admin. Either way, a Recap can't change after an Admin has reviewed it.\n\n---\n\n❓ **Q3 - Can an Editor delete their own Recap?**\n\n➡️ Only while it's a Draft. Once it's Submitted or Published, deleting it is an Admin's call. That keeps an Admin's review work from disappearing without warning.\n\n---\n\n❓ **Q4 - Where does an Editor's Byline come from?** Byline means name plus class year, and both are required.\n\n➡️ The Editor's **account stores their name and class year**, and their Recaps take the Byline from it automatically, so Editors never type it. When an Admin enters a Recap for a Contributor, they type the Byline by hand. An Admin's own Recap uses the Admin's account details.\n\n---\n\nOnce you've answered, I'll update `CONTEXT.md` (adding **Submitted** if you agree to Q1) and give you the final summary to confirm."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1839,"cache_read_input_tokens":82502,"output_tokens":729,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":82},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1839,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":729,"cache_read_input_tokens":82502,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1839,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1839},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"1def3f0d-b204-4983-b6d9-3fc77a442faf","apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011CgMCxyGpxrfTp8cfswxgb","requestRef":"ed0ce37f-1337-4451-9a29-f44caed64879","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","type":"assistant","uuid":"05c56b2d-0e7b-4842-b260-4db08325ee83","timestamp":"2026-10-24T14:18:47.919Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3c83bfcc-3eab-41bd-893a-8b0e0abb030e","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

An Editor's or Admin's Byline comes from their account, and an Admin types a Contributor's Byline by hand.","originalFile":"# Kenyon Model UN Recaps\n\nA content system where the Kenyon Model UN club's officers publish recaps of the club's conference trips for the Kenyon community.\n\n## Content\n\n**Trip**:\nOne conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Trip carries its own required Summary of what the trip was, and groups the Recaps written about it.\n_Avoid_: Event, conference (as the record's name)\n\n**Summary**:\nAn Admin-written overview on a Trip: the conference, where it was, and what happened overall. Readers see it at the top of the Trip's page.\n_Avoid_: Description, intro\n\n**Recap**:\nOne club member's personal account of exactly one Trip, with text and optional photos. It is written by an Editor, or entered by an Admin for a Contributor. Recaps are individual anecdotes, while the Trip's Summary says what the trip was. A Trip can have several Recaps.\n_Avoid_: Post, blog, article\n\n**Byline**:\nThe writer's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required.\n_Avoid_: Author (an Admin who typed a Recap in is not its writer)\n\n**Image**:\nA photo uploaded into the system and placed inline in a Recap's body, always with alt text. Recaps show only uploaded Images, never ones hosted elsewhere.\n_Avoid_: Media, attachment, embed\n\n## Publishing\n\n**Draft**:\nA Recap's status while it is not yet meant for readers. Every Recap starts as a Draft, and Drafts never leave the database.\n\n**Published**:\nA Recap's status once an Admin has approved it for the public site. A Published Recap is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\n\n**Publish / Unpublish**:\nMoving a Recap from Draft to Published, or back. Only Admins Publish or Unpublish.\n_Avoid_: using \"publish\" for rebuilding the site\n\n**Deploy**:\nRebuilding the public site from every Published Recap and pushing it live. Only Admins deploy. The assignment names the command `cms publish`. That command performs a Deploy, despite its name.\n_Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push\n\n**Backup**:\nA dated archive of the database and uploaded Images, kept somewhere private outside the repository. It is the only copy of Drafts and Recap sources if the Console laptop is lost. Only Admins make Backups.\n\n## Operations\n\n**Console laptop**:\nThe single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Admins work on it, and Editors log in on it during the Sunday club meetings.\n\n**Handover**:\nThe yearly transfer to new officers: outgoing Admins create the incoming Admins' accounts, incoming Admins remove the outgoing ones, and the Console laptop or latest Backup moves with them. The last Admin can never be removed.\n\n## People\n\n**Admin**:\nThe club's President or Vice President. Admins can do everything an Editor can, and also Publish and Unpublish, create Trips, manage accounts, Deploy, and make Backups. They can edit any Recap and enter one on a Contributor's behalf.\n_Avoid_: Officer (in the system), superuser\n\n**Editor**:\nA club member with their own account who writes their own Recaps as Drafts and adds Images, with alt text, to them. The President and VP decide which members become Editors, and an Admin creates the account. An Editor cannot Publish or Unpublish, create Trips, manage accounts, Deploy, make Backups, or edit another person's Recap.\n_Avoid_: Author, writer, contributor (for this role)\n\n**Contributor**:\nA member whose writing an Admin enters for them, for example because they missed a Sunday meeting and emailed it in. A Contributor has no account of their own.\n_Avoid_: Editor (for this role), author, writer\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":17,"oldLines":7,"newStart":17,"newLines":7,"lines":[" _Avoid_: Post, blog, article"," "," **Byline**:","-The writer's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required.","+The writer's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required. An Editor's or Admin's Byline comes from their account, and an Admin types a Contributor's Byline by hand."," _Avoid_: Author (an Admin who typed a Recap in is not its writer)"," "," **Image**:"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"349aeb7f-81d6-4138-9d56-6d1756d92b98","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3c83bfcc-3eab-41bd-893a-8b0e0abb030e","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

Only Admins Publish or Unpublish.","newString":"A Recap's status while its writer is still working on it. Every Recap starts as a Draft, and Drafts never leave the database.\n\n**Submitted**:\nA Recap's status once its Editor says it is finished and ready for an Admin to review. Nobody but an Admin can change it from here.\n_Avoid_: Pending, in review\n\n**Published**:\nA Recap's status once an Admin has approved it for the public site. A Published Recap is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\n\n**Submit**:\nAn Editor moving their own Recap from Draft to Submitted.\n\n**Send back**:\nAn Admin returning a Submitted Recap to Draft so its Editor can revise it.\n_Avoid_: Reject\n\n**Publish / Unpublish**:\nMoving a Recap to Published, or from Published back to Draft. Only Admins Publish or Unpublish.","originalFile":"# Kenyon Model UN Recaps\n\nA content system where the Kenyon Model UN club's officers publish recaps of the club's conference trips for the Kenyon community.\n\n## Content\n\n**Trip**:\nOne conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Trip carries its own required Summary of what the trip was, and groups the Recaps written about it.\n_Avoid_: Event, conference (as the record's name)\n\n**Summary**:\nAn Admin-written overview on a Trip: the conference, where it was, and what happened overall. Readers see it at the top of the Trip's page.\n_Avoid_: Description, intro\n\n**Recap**:\nOne club member's personal account of exactly one Trip, with text and optional photos. It is written by an Editor, or entered by an Admin for a Contributor. Recaps are individual anecdotes, while the Trip's Summary says what the trip was. A Trip can have several Recaps.\n_Avoid_: Post, blog, article\n\n**Byline**:\nThe writer's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required. An Editor's or Admin's Byline comes from their account, and an Admin types a Contributor's Byline by hand.\n_Avoid_: Author (an Admin who typed a Recap in is not its writer)\n\n**Image**:\nA photo uploaded into the system and placed inline in a Recap's body, always with alt text. Recaps show only uploaded Images, never ones hosted elsewhere.\n_Avoid_: Media, attachment, embed\n\n## Publishing\n\n**Draft**:\nA Recap's status while it is not yet meant for readers. Every Recap starts as a Draft, and Drafts never leave the database.\n\n**Published**:\nA Recap's status once an Admin has approved it for the public site. A Published Recap is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\n\n**Publish / Unpublish**:\nMoving a Recap from Draft to Published, or back. Only Admins Publish or Unpublish.\n_Avoid_: using \"publish\" for rebuilding the site\n\n**Deploy**:\nRebuilding the public site from every Published Recap and pushing it live. Only Admins deploy. The assignment names the command `cms publish`. That command performs a Deploy, despite its name.\n_Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push\n\n**Backup**:\nA dated archive of the database and uploaded Images, kept somewhere private outside the repository. It is the only copy of Drafts and Recap sources if the Console laptop is lost. Only Admins make Backups.\n\n## Operations\n\n**Console laptop**:\nThe single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Admins work on it, and Editors log in on it during the Sunday club meetings.\n\n**Handover**:\nThe yearly transfer to new officers: outgoing Admins create the incoming Admins' accounts, incoming Admins remove the outgoing ones, and the Console laptop or latest Backup moves with them. The last Admin can never be removed.\n\n## People\n\n**Admin**:\nThe club's President or Vice President. Admins can do everything an Editor can, and also Publish and Unpublish, create Trips, manage accounts, Deploy, and make Backups. They can edit any Recap and enter one on a Contributor's behalf.\n_Avoid_: Officer (in the system), superuser\n\n**Editor**:\nA club member with their own account who writes their own Recaps as Drafts and adds Images, with alt text, to them. The President and VP decide which members become Editors, and an Admin creates the account. An Editor cannot Publish or Unpublish, create Trips, manage accounts, Deploy, make Backups, or edit another person's Recap.\n_Avoid_: Author, writer, contributor (for this role)\n\n**Contributor**:\nA member whose writing an Admin enters for them, for example because they missed a Sunday meeting and emailed it in. A Contributor has no account of their own.\n_Avoid_: Editor (for this role), author, writer\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":27,"oldLines":13,"newStart":27,"newLines":24,"lines":[" ## Publishing"," "," **Draft**:","-A Recap's status while it is not yet meant for readers. {"parentUuid":"4875c82c-bf36-4337-aa80-f61a2092f237","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMD6B7AmbX4ihNJVNmas","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've updated `CONTEXT.md` with your four answers. It gains three terms: **Submitted**, **Submit**, and **Send back**. **Draft**, **Publish/Unpublish**, **Editor**, and **Byline** are reworded to match. There are no open questions left, so here is the full design for you to confirm.\n\n**Roles**\n- **Admin** (the President and VP) can do everything an Editor can. Admins also Publish and Unpublish, Send back, create Trips, manage accounts, Deploy, and run `cms backup`. They can edit any Recap and can enter one for a **Contributor**, meaning a member who emailed their writing in.\n- **Editor** is a member chosen by the President and VP, with an account an Admin creates. Editors log in on the **Console laptop** during the Sunday club meetings. An Editor writes their own Recaps, adds Images with alt text, and Submits them. They can edit or delete a Recap only while it's a Draft.\n- This is recorded in ADR-003. Remote editing is out of scope.\n\n**How a Recap moves**\n- An Editor's Recap goes **Draft → Submit → Submitted**. An Admin then either **Publishes** it or **Sends it back** to Draft.\n- Unpublish returns a Published Recap to Draft.\n- **Deploy** (the `cms publish` command) is what makes changes visible to readers. If an Admin edits or Unpublishes a Recap that's already live, they see a warning saying it stays live until the next Deploy.\n\n**Content**\n- **Trip**: name, city, dates, and a required **Summary**. Only Admins create Trips, and a Trip can't be deleted while it still has Recaps.\n- **Recap**: belongs to exactly one Trip and must have text.\n- **Byline**: name plus class year. For Editors and Admins it comes from their account; for a Contributor, an Admin types it.\n- **Images**: uploaded only, as JPEG, PNG, or WebP up to about 5 MB, with required alt text. Each one is placed in the Recap with a snippet you paste in, and you check placement with Preview.\n- Recap bodies can't contain external images or links.\n\n**Public site**\n- The home page lists Trips, newest first.\n- A Trip appears only once it has a Published Recap. Its page shows the Summary, then its Recaps in the order they were Published.\n- All paths are relative, in the form `trips/2026-chicago/<recap>/`.\n- The footer has one link to the club's Instagram. Comments are a known gap.\n\n**Operations**\n- One Console laptop holds the only database.\n- `cms backup` produces a dated archive that is stored privately and never committed to git.\n- **Handover** happens yearly. The last Admin can never be removed.\n\n**Files changed so far:** `CONTEXT.md` and `docs/adr/ADR-003-editors-at-sunday-meetings.md`. Nothing is committed yet.\n\nDoes this match what you want? If it does, the next step is committing these two files and moving to the spec. A Recap's Slug is unique within its Trip, and a Page's Slug is unique among Pages.\n_Avoid_: Permalink, path, handle","originalFile":"# Kenyon Model UN Recaps\n\nA content system where the Kenyon Model UN club's officers publish recaps of the club's conference trips for the Kenyon community.\n\n## Content\n\n**Trip**:\nOne conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Trip carries its own required Summary of what the trip was, and groups the Recaps written about it.\n_Avoid_: Event, conference (as the record's name)\n\n**Summary**:\nAn Admin-written overview on a Trip: the conference, where it was, and what happened overall. Readers see it at the top of the Trip's page.\n_Avoid_: Description, intro\n\n**Recap**:\nOne club member's personal account of exactly one Trip, with text and optional photos. It is written by an Editor, or entered by an Admin for a Contributor. Recaps are individual anecdotes, while the Trip's Summary says what the trip was. A Trip can have several Recaps.\n_Avoid_: Post, blog, article\n\n**Byline**:\nThe writer's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required. An Editor's or Admin's Byline comes from their account, and an Admin types a Contributor's Byline by hand.\n_Avoid_: Author (an Admin who typed a Recap in is not its writer)\n\n**Image**:\nA photo uploaded into the system and placed inline in a Recap's body, always with alt text. Recaps show only uploaded Images, never ones hosted elsewhere.\n_Avoid_: Media, attachment, embed\n\n## Publishing\n\n**Draft**:\nA Recap's status while its writer is still working on it. Every Recap starts as a Draft, and Drafts never leave the database.\n\n**Submitted**:\nA Recap's status once its Editor says it is finished and ready for an Admin to review. Nobody but an Admin can change it from here.\n_Avoid_: Pending, in review\n\n**Published**:\nA Recap's status once an Admin has approved it for the public site. A Published Recap is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\n\n**Submit**:\nAn Editor moving their own Recap from Draft to Submitted.\n\n**Send back**:\nAn Admin returning a Submitted Recap to Draft so its Editor can revise it.\n_Avoid_: Reject\n\n**Publish / Unpublish**:\nMoving a Recap to Published, or from Published back to Draft. Only Admins Publish or Unpublish.\n_Avoid_: using \"publish\" for rebuilding the site\n\n**Deploy**:\nRebuilding the public site from every Published Recap and pushing it live. Only Admins deploy. The assignment names the command `cms publish`. That command performs a Deploy, despite its name.\n_Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push\n\n**Backup**:\nA dated archive of the database and uploaded Images, kept somewhere private outside the repository. It is the only copy of Drafts and Recap sources if the Console laptop is lost. Only Admins make Backups.\n\n## Operations\n\n**Console laptop**:\nThe single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Admins work on it, and Editors log in on it during the Sunday club meetings.\n\n**Handover**:\nThe yearly transfer to new officers: outgoing Admins create the incoming Admins' accounts, incoming Admins remove the outgoing ones, and the Console laptop or latest Backup moves with them. The last Admin can never be removed.\n\n## People\n\n**Admin**:\nThe club's President or Vice President. Admins can do everything an Editor can, and also Publish and Unpublish, create Trips, manage accounts, Deploy, and make Backups. They can edit any Recap and enter one on a Contributor's behalf.\n_Avoid_: Officer (in the system), superuser\n\n**Editor**:\nA club member with their own account who writes their own Recaps as Drafts, adds Images with alt text to them, and Submits them. An Editor can edit or delete their own Recap only while it is a Draft. The President and VP decide which members become Editors, and an Admin creates the account. An Editor cannot Publish or Unpublish, create Trips, manage accounts, Deploy, make Backups, or edit another person's Recap.\n_Avoid_: Author, writer, contributor (for this role)\n\n**Contributor**:\nA member whose writing an Admin enters for them, for example because they missed a Sunday meeting and emailed it in. A Contributor has no account of their own.\n_Avoid_: Editor (for this role), author, writer\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":13,"oldLines":9,"newStart":13,"newLines":13,"lines":[" _Avoid_: Description, intro"," "," **Recap**:","-One club member's personal account of exactly one Trip, with text and optional photos.
