Every Recap and Page starts as a Draft, and Drafts never leave the database.","originalFile":"# Kenyon Model UN Recaps\n\nA content system where the Kenyon Model UN club's officers publish recaps of the club's conference trips for the Kenyon community.\n\n## Content\n\n**Trip**:\nOne conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Trip carries its own required Summary of what the trip was, and groups the Recaps written about it.\n_Avoid_: Event, conference (as the record's name)\n\n**Summary**:\nAn Admin-written overview on a Trip: the conference, where it was, and what happened overall. Readers see it at the top of the Trip's page.\n_Avoid_: Description, intro\n\n**Recap**:\nOne club member's personal account of exactly one Trip. A Recap has a title, a Slug, body text with optional Images, a Byline, and records of when it was created, last edited, and Published. It is written by an Editor, or entered by an Admin for a Contributor. Recaps are individual anecdotes, while the Trip's Summary says what the trip was. A Trip can have several Recaps.\n_Avoid_: Post, blog, article\n\n**Slug**:\nThe short, URL-safe name that identifies a Recap or Page in the public site's addresses, such as `chicago-food-crawl`. A Recap's Slug is unique within its Trip, and a Page's Slug is unique among Pages.\n_Avoid_: Permalink, path, handle\n\n**Byline**:\nThe writer's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required. An Editor's or Admin's Byline comes from their account, and an Admin types a Contributor's Byline by hand.\n_Avoid_: Author (an Admin who typed a Recap in is not its writer)\n\n**Image**:\nA photo uploaded into the system and placed inline in a Recap's body, always with alt text. Recaps show only uploaded Images, never ones hosted elsewhere.\n_Avoid_: Media, attachment, embed\n\n**Page**:\nStanding content about the club that is not tied to a Trip, such as \"About the club\" or \"Officers and contact\". A Page has a title, a Slug, a body, and a Draft or Published status. Only Admins create or edit Pages.\n_Avoid_: Static page, post\n\n**Navigation bar**:\nThe list of links across the top of the public site, built from the Published Pages.\n_Avoid_: Menu, header links\n\n## Publishing\n\n**Draft**:\nA Recap's status while its writer is still working on it. Every Recap starts as a Draft, and Drafts never leave the database.\n\n**Submitted**:\nA Recap's status once its Editor says it is finished and ready for an Admin to review. Nobody but an Admin can change it from here.\n_Avoid_: Pending, in review\n\n**Published**:\nA Recap's status once an Admin has approved it for the public site. A Published Recap is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\n\n**Submit**:\nAn Editor moving their own Recap from Draft to Submitted.\n\n**Send back**:\nAn Admin returning a Submitted Recap to Draft so its Editor can revise it.\n_Avoid_: Reject\n\n**Publish / Unpublish**:\nMoving a Recap to Published, or from Published back to Draft. Only Admins Publish or Unpublish.\n_Avoid_: using \"publish\" for rebuilding the site\n\n**Deploy**:\nRebuilding the public site from every Published Recap and pushing it live. Only Admins deploy. The assignment names the command `cms publish`. That command performs a Deploy, despite its name.\n_Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push\n\n**Backup**:\nA dated archive of the database and uploaded Images, kept somewhere private outside the repository. It is the only copy of Drafts and Recap sources if the Console laptop is lost. Only Admins make Backups.\n\n## Operations\n\n**Console laptop**:\nThe single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Admins work on it, and Editors log in on it during the Sunday club meetings.\n\n**Handover**:\nThe yearly transfer to new officers: outgoing Admins create the incoming Admins' accounts, incoming Admins remove the outgoing ones, and the Console laptop or latest Backup moves with them. The last Admin can never be removed.\n\n## People\n\n**Admin**:\nThe club's President or Vice President. Admins can do everything an Editor can, and also Publish and Unpublish, create Trips, manage accounts, Deploy, and make Backups. They can edit any Recap and enter one on a Contributor's behalf.\n_Avoid_: Officer (in the system), superuser\n\n**Editor**:\nA club member with their own account who writes their own Recaps as Drafts, adds Images with alt text to them, and Submits them. An Editor can edit or delete their own Recap only while it is a Draft. The President and VP decide which members become Editors, and an Admin creates the account. An Editor cannot Publish or Unpublish, create Trips, manage accounts, Deploy, make Backups, or edit another person's Recap.\n_Avoid_: Author, writer, contributor (for this role)\n\n**Contributor**:\nA member whose writing an Admin enters for them, for example because they missed a Sunday meeting and emailed it in. A Contributor has no account of their own.\n_Avoid_: Editor (for this role), author, writer\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":39,"oldLines":7,"newStart":39,"newLines":7,"lines":[" ## Publishing"," "," **Draft**:","-A Recap's status while its writer is still working on it. Every Recap starts as a Draft, and Drafts never leave the database.","+A Recap's or Page's status while it is still being written. Every Recap and Page starts as a Draft, and Drafts never leave the database."," "," **Submitted**:"," A Recap's status once its Editor says it is finished and ready for an Admin to review. Nobody but an Admin can change it from here."]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"5278abcc-0d39-41a1-bff4-eb28e710915c","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3c83bfcc-3eab-41bd-893a-8b0e0abb030e","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

Only Admins Publish or Unpublish.","originalFile":"# Kenyon Model UN Recaps\n\nA content system where the Kenyon Model UN club's officers publish recaps of the club's conference trips for the Kenyon community.\n\n## Content\n\n**Trip**:\nOne conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Trip carries its own required Summary of what the trip was, and groups the Recaps written about it.\n_Avoid_: Event, conference (as the record's name)\n\n**Summary**:\nAn Admin-written overview on a Trip: the conference, where it was, and what happened overall. Readers see it at the top of the Trip's page.\n_Avoid_: Description, intro\n\n**Recap**:\nOne club member's personal account of exactly one Trip. A Recap has a title, a Slug, body text with optional Images, a Byline, and records of when it was created, last edited, and Published. It is written by an Editor, or entered by an Admin for a Contributor. Recaps are individual anecdotes, while the Trip's Summary says what the trip was. A Trip can have several Recaps.\n_Avoid_: Post, blog, article\n\n**Slug**:\nThe short, URL-safe name that identifies a Recap or Page in the public site's addresses, such as `chicago-food-crawl`. A Recap's Slug is unique within its Trip, and a Page's Slug is unique among Pages.\n_Avoid_: Permalink, path, handle\n\n**Byline**:\nThe writer's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required. An Editor's or Admin's Byline comes from their account, and an Admin types a Contributor's Byline by hand.\n_Avoid_: Author (an Admin who typed a Recap in is not its writer)\n\n**Image**:\nA photo uploaded into the system and placed inline in a Recap's body, always with alt text. Recaps show only uploaded Images, never ones hosted elsewhere.\n_Avoid_: Media, attachment, embed\n\n**Page**:\nStanding content about the club that is not tied to a Trip, such as \"About the club\" or \"Officers and contact\". A Page has a title, a Slug, a body, and a Draft or Published status. Only Admins create or edit Pages.\n_Avoid_: Static page, post\n\n**Navigation bar**:\nThe list of links across the top of the public site, built from the Published Pages.\n_Avoid_: Menu, header links\n\n## Publishing\n\n**Draft**:\nA Recap's or Page's status while it is still being written. Every Recap and Page starts as a Draft, and Drafts never leave the database.\n\n**Submitted**:\nA Recap's status once its Editor says it is finished and ready for an Admin to review. Nobody but an Admin can change it from here.\n_Avoid_: Pending, in review\n\n**Published**:\nA Recap's or Page's status once an Admin has approved it for the public site. It is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\n\n**Submit**:\nAn Editor moving their own Recap from Draft to Submitted.\n\n**Send back**:\nAn Admin returning a Submitted Recap to Draft so its Editor can revise it.\n_Avoid_: Reject\n\n**Publish / Unpublish**:\nMoving a Recap to Published, or from Published back to Draft. Only Admins Publish or Unpublish.\n_Avoid_: using \"publish\" for rebuilding the site\n\n**Deploy**:\nRebuilding the public site from every Published Recap and pushing it live. Only Admins deploy. The assignment names the command `cms publish`. That command performs a Deploy, despite its name.\n_Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push\n\n**Backup**:\nA dated archive of the database and uploaded Images, kept somewhere private outside the repository. It is the only copy of Drafts and Recap sources if the Console laptop is lost. Only Admins make Backups.\n\n## Operations\n\n**Console laptop**:\nThe single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Admins work on it, and Editors log in on it during the Sunday club meetings.\n\n**Handover**:\nThe yearly transfer to new officers: outgoing Admins create the incoming Admins' accounts, incoming Admins remove the outgoing ones, and the Console laptop or latest Backup moves with them. The last Admin can never be removed.\n\n## People\n\n**Admin**:\nThe club's President or Vice President. Admins can do everything an Editor can, and also Publish and Unpublish, create Trips, manage accounts, Deploy, and make Backups. They can edit any Recap and enter one on a Contributor's behalf.\n_Avoid_: Officer (in the system), superuser\n\n**Editor**:\nA club member with their own account who writes their own Recaps as Drafts, adds Images with alt text to them, and Submits them. An Editor can edit or delete their own Recap only while it is a Draft. The President and VP decide which members become Editors, and an Admin creates the account. An Editor cannot Publish or Unpublish, create Trips, manage accounts, Deploy, make Backups, or edit another person's Recap.\n_Avoid_: Author, writer, contributor (for this role)\n\n**Contributor**:\nA member whose writing an Admin enters for them, for example because they missed a Sunday meeting and emailed it in. A Contributor has no account of their own.\n_Avoid_: Editor (for this role), author, writer\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":56,"oldLines":7,"newStart":56,"newLines":7,"lines":[" _Avoid_: Reject"," "," **Publish / Unpublish**:","-Moving a Recap to Published, or from Published back to Draft. Only Admins Publish or Unpublish.","+Moving a Recap or Page to Published, or from Published back to Draft. Only Admins Publish or Unpublish."," _Avoid_: using \"publish\" for rebuilding the site"," "," **Deploy**:"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"536eb87b-96f6-4d3f-bb61-e7bf0a4aa225","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3c83bfcc-3eab-41bd-893a-8b0e0abb030e","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"4b6e46a9-b885-44e0-ac3c-c58818eef20d","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"a08a4acb-57e7-4bda-811d-b568c128a96d","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Ad45hKaYrTc25oXZx33ss7","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/CONTEXT.md has been updated successfully. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"61a64a19-eeac-4921-9863-d6ebb68d732c","timestamp":"2026-10-24T14:22:52.546Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/CONTEXT.md","oldString":"and also Publish and Unpublish, create Trips, manage accounts,","newString":"and also Publish and Unpublish, create Trips, create and edit Pages, manage accounts,","originalFile":"# Kenyon Model UN Recaps\n\nA content system where the Kenyon Model UN club's officers publish recaps of the club's conference trips for the Kenyon community.\n\n## Content\n\n**Trip**:\nOne conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Trip carries its own required Summary of what the trip was, and groups the Recaps written about it.\n_Avoid_: Event, conference (as the record's name)\n\n**Summary**:\nAn Admin-written overview on a Trip: the conference, where it was, and what happened overall. Readers see it at the top of the Trip's page.\n_Avoid_: Description, intro\n\n**Recap**:\nOne club member's personal account of exactly one Trip. A Recap has a title, a Slug, body text with optional Images, a Byline, and records of when it was created, last edited, and Published. It is written by an Editor, or entered by an Admin for a Contributor. Recaps are individual anecdotes, while the Trip's Summary says what the trip was. A Trip can have several Recaps.\n_Avoid_: Post, blog, article\n\n**Slug**:\nThe short, URL-safe name that identifies a Recap or Page in the public site's addresses, such as `chicago-food-crawl`. A Recap's Slug is unique within its Trip, and a Page's Slug is unique among Pages.\n_Avoid_: Permalink, path, handle\n\n**Byline**:\nThe writer's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required. An Editor's or Admin's Byline comes from their account, and an Admin types a Contributor's Byline by hand.\n_Avoid_: Author (an Admin who typed a Recap in is not its writer)\n\n**Image**:\nA photo uploaded into the system and placed inline in a Recap's body, always with alt text. Recaps show only uploaded Images, never ones hosted elsewhere.\n_Avoid_: Media, attachment, embed\n\n**Page**:\nStanding content about the club that is not tied to a Trip, such as \"About the club\" or \"Officers and contact\". A Page has a title, a Slug, a body, and a Draft or Published status. Only Admins create or edit Pages.\n_Avoid_: Static page, post\n\n**Navigation bar**:\nThe list of links across the top of the public site, built from the Published Pages.\n_Avoid_: Menu, header links\n\n## Publishing\n\n**Draft**:\nA Recap's or Page's status while it is still being written. Every Recap and Page starts as a Draft, and Drafts never leave the database.\n\n**Submitted**:\nA Recap's status once its Editor says it is finished and ready for an Admin to review. Nobody but an Admin can change it from here.\n_Avoid_: Pending, in review\n\n**Published**:\nA Recap's or Page's status once an Admin has approved it for the public site. It is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\n\n**Submit**:\nAn Editor moving their own Recap from Draft to Submitted.\n\n**Send back**:\nAn Admin returning a Submitted Recap to Draft so its Editor can revise it.\n_Avoid_: Reject\n\n**Publish / Unpublish**:\nMoving a Recap or Page to Published, or from Published back to Draft. Only Admins Publish or Unpublish.\n_Avoid_: using \"publish\" for rebuilding the site\n\n**Deploy**:\nRebuilding the public site from every Published Recap and Page and pushing it live. Only Admins deploy. The assignment names the command `cms publish`. That command performs a Deploy, despite its name.\n_Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push\n\n**Backup**:\nA dated archive of the database and uploaded Images, kept somewhere private outside the repository. It is the only copy of Drafts and Recap sources if the Console laptop is lost. Only Admins make Backups.\n\n## Operations\n\n**Console laptop**:\nThe single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Admins work on it, and Editors log in on it during the Sunday club meetings.\n\n**Handover**:\nThe yearly transfer to new officers: outgoing Admins create the incoming Admins' accounts, incoming Admins remove the outgoing ones, and the Console laptop or latest Backup moves with them. The last Admin can never be removed.\n\n## People\n\n**Admin**:\nThe club's President or Vice President. Admins can do everything an Editor can, and also Publish and Unpublish, create Trips, manage accounts, Deploy, and make Backups. They can edit any Recap and enter one on a Contributor's behalf.\n_Avoid_: Officer (in the system), superuser\n\n**Editor**:\nA club member with their own account who writes their own Recaps as Drafts, adds Images with alt text to them, and Submits them. An Editor can edit or delete their own Recap only while it is a Draft. The President and VP decide which members become Editors, and an Admin creates the account. An Editor cannot Publish or Unpublish, create Trips, manage accounts, Deploy, make Backups, or edit another person's Recap.\n_Avoid_: Author, writer, contributor (for this role)\n\n**Contributor**:\nA member whose writing an Admin enters for them, for example because they missed a Sunday meeting and emailed it in. A Contributor has no account of their own.\n_Avoid_: Editor (for this role), author, writer\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":77,"oldLines":7,"newStart":77,"newLines":7,"lines":[" ## People"," "," **Admin**:","-The club's President or Vice President. Admins can do everything an Editor can, and also Publish and Unpublish, create Trips, manage accounts, Deploy, and make Backups. They can edit any Recap and enter one on a Contributor's behalf.","+The club's President or Vice President. Admins can do everything an Editor can, and also Publish and Unpublish, create Trips, create and edit Pages, manage accounts, Deploy, and make Backups. They can edit any Recap and enter one on a Contributor's behalf."," _Avoid_: Officer (in the system), superuser"," "," **Editor**:"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"4b6e46a9-b885-44e0-ac3c-c58818eef20d","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3c83bfcc-3eab-41bd-893a-8b0e0abb030e","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"cde2f4cc-32ca-4de7-95da-af3ab8d97ab0","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMDHb3tC34vgZamYTWiX","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've added Pages and the Recap fields to `CONTEXT.md`. Nothing is committed.\n\n## Changed parts of `CONTEXT.md`\n\n**New terms**\n\n> **Slug**:\n> The short, URL-safe name that identifies a Recap or Page in the public site's addresses, such as `chicago-food-crawl`. A Recap's Slug is unique within its Trip, and a Page's Slug is unique among Pages.\n> _Avoid_: Permalink, path, handle\n>\n> **Page**:\n> Standing content about the club that is not tied to a Trip, such as \"About the club\" or \"Officers and contact\". A Page has a title, a Slug, a body, and a Draft or Published status. Only Admins create or edit Pages.\n> _Avoid_: Static page, post\n>\n> **Navigation bar**:\n> The list of links across the top of the public site, built from the Published Pages.\n> _Avoid_: Menu, header links\n\n**Recap** (rewritten)\n\n> One club member's personal account of exactly one Trip. A Recap has a title, a Slug, body text with optional Images, a Byline, and records of when it was created, last edited, and Published. It is written by an Editor, or entered by an Admin for a Contributor. …\n\n**Changed to include Pages**\n- **Draft**: \"A Recap's or Page's status while it is still being written. Every Recap and Page starts as a Draft, and Drafts never leave the database.\"\n- **Published**: \"A Recap's or Page's status once an Admin has approved it for the public site. It is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\"\n- **Publish / Unpublish**: \"Moving a Recap or Page to Published, or from Published back to Draft. Only Admins Publish or Unpublish.\"\n- **Deploy**: \"Rebuilding the public site from every Published Recap and Page and pushing it live.\"\n- **Admin**: the list of what only Admins can do now includes \"create and edit Pages\".\n- **Editor**: the list of what Editors can't do now includes \"create or edit Pages\".\n\nI kept **Submitted** for Recaps only. Admins write Pages themselves, so Pages have no review step.\n\n## Questions about Pages and Slugs\n\n❓ **Q1 - Trips need a Slug too.** We settled on Recap addresses like `trips/2026-chicago/<recap>/`. The `2026-chicago` part is a Trip Slug. Should **Slug** cover Trips as well, unique among Trips?\n➡️ Yes. An Admin sets the Trip's Slug when creating the Trip, with a suggested default built from the year and the city.\n\n❓ **Q2 - Page Slugs that clash with site paths.** If an Admin names a Page `trips`, its address collides with the Trip pages.\n➡️ Pages live at the top level (`about/`), and the system refuses reserved Slugs such as `trips` and `images`.\n\n❓ **Q3 - Navigation bar order.** In what order do Published Pages appear in the Navigation bar?\n➡️ Each Page gets a number that sets its position, chosen by an Admin. A \"Home\" link always comes first.\n\n❓ **Q4 - Images on Pages.** Can a Page contain uploaded Images, for example officer photos on \"Officers and contact\"? If so, the same alt-text requirement and the same ban on external images would apply.\n➡️ Yes, with the same rules as Recaps."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3238,"cache_read_input_tokens":87864,"output_tokens":1199,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":78},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3238,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1199,"cache_read_input_tokens":87864,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3238,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3238},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"9cbddcbe-e2fe-45bc-bc32-95863c15465c","apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011CgMDHajHwoh8BA4Xvghxk","requestRef":"dc8878dc-fd79-429b-bcbd-39f2467649ad","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","type":"assistant","uuid":"51bd05fe-e99d-4565-b9f7-140e451f319e","timestamp":"2026-10-24T14:23:03.743Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3c83bfcc-3eab-41bd-893a-8b0e0abb030e","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

A Recap's Slug is unique within its Trip, and a Page's Slug is unique among Pages.","newString":"The short, URL-safe name that identifies a Trip, Recap, or Page in the public site's addresses, such as `2026-chicago` or `chicago-food-crawl`. A Page cannot take a Slug the site already uses, such as `trips` or `images`.","originalFile":"# Kenyon Model UN Recaps\n\nA content system where the Kenyon Model UN club's officers publish recaps of the club's conference trips for the Kenyon community.\n\n## Content\n\n**Trip**:\nOne conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Trip carries its own required Summary of what the trip was, and groups the Recaps written about it.\n_Avoid_: Event, conference (as the record's name)\n\n**Summary**:\nAn Admin-written overview on a Trip: the conference, where it was, and what happened overall. Readers see it at the top of the Trip's page.\n_Avoid_: Description, intro\n\n**Recap**:\nOne club member's personal account of exactly one Trip. A Recap has a title, a Slug, body text with optional Images, a Byline, and records of when it was created, last edited, and Published. It is written by an Editor, or entered by an Admin for a Contributor. Recaps are individual anecdotes, while the Trip's Summary says what the trip was. A Trip can have several Recaps.\n_Avoid_: Post, blog, article\n\n**Slug**:\nThe short, URL-safe name that identifies a Recap or Page in the public site's addresses, such as `chicago-food-crawl`. A Recap's Slug is unique within its Trip, and a Page's Slug is unique among Pages.\n_Avoid_: Permalink, path, handle\n\n**Byline**:\nThe writer's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required. An Editor's or Admin's Byline comes from their account, and an Admin types a Contributor's Byline by hand.\n_Avoid_: Author (an Admin who typed a Recap in is not its writer)\n\n**Image**:\nA photo uploaded into the system and placed inline in a Recap's body, always with alt text. Recaps show only uploaded Images, never ones hosted elsewhere.\n_Avoid_: Media, attachment, embed\n\n**Page**:\nStanding content about the club that is not tied to a Trip, such as \"About the club\" or \"Officers and contact\". A Page has a title, a Slug, a body, and a Draft or Published status. Only Admins create or edit Pages.\n_Avoid_: Static page, post\n\n**Navigation bar**:\nThe list of links across the top of the public site, built from the Published Pages.\n_Avoid_: Menu, header links\n\n## Publishing\n\n**Draft**:\nA Recap's or Page's status while it is still being written. Every Recap and Page starts as a Draft, and Drafts never leave the database.\n\n**Submitted**:\nA Recap's status once its Editor says it is finished and ready for an Admin to review. Nobody but an Admin can change it from here.\n_Avoid_: Pending, in review\n\n**Published**:\nA Recap's or Page's status once an Admin has approved it for the public site. It is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\n\n**Submit**:\nAn Editor moving their own Recap from Draft to Submitted.\n\n**Send back**:\nAn Admin returning a Submitted Recap to Draft so its Editor can revise it.\n_Avoid_: Reject\n\n**Publish / Unpublish**:\nMoving a Recap or Page to Published, or from Published back to Draft. Only Admins Publish or Unpublish.\n_Avoid_: using \"publish\" for rebuilding the site\n\n**Deploy**:\nRebuilding the public site from every Published Recap and Page and pushing it live. Only Admins deploy. The assignment names the command `cms publish`. That command performs a Deploy, despite its name.\n_Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push\n\n**Backup**:\nA dated archive of the database and uploaded Images, kept somewhere private outside the repository. It is the only copy of Drafts and Recap sources if the Console laptop is lost. Only Admins make Backups.\n\n## Operations\n\n**Console laptop**:\nThe single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Admins work on it, and Editors log in on it during the Sunday club meetings.\n\n**Handover**:\nThe yearly transfer to new officers: outgoing Admins create the incoming Admins' accounts, incoming Admins remove the outgoing ones, and the Console laptop or latest Backup moves with them. The last Admin can never be removed.\n\n## People\n\n**Admin**:\nThe club's President or Vice President. Admins can do everything an Editor can, and also Publish and Unpublish, create Trips, create and edit Pages, manage accounts, Deploy, and make Backups. They can edit any Recap and enter one on a Contributor's behalf.\n_Avoid_: Officer (in the system), superuser\n\n**Editor**:\nA club member with their own account who writes their own Recaps as Drafts, adds Images with alt text to them, and Submits them. An Editor can edit or delete their own Recap only while it is a Draft. The President and VP decide which members become Editors, and an Admin creates the account. An Editor cannot Publish or Unpublish, create Trips, create or edit Pages, manage accounts, Deploy, make Backups, or edit another person's Recap.\n_Avoid_: Author, writer, contributor (for this role)\n\n**Contributor**:\nA member whose writing an Admin enters for them, for example because they missed a Sunday meeting and emailed it in. A Contributor has no account of their own.\n_Avoid_: Editor (for this role), author, writer\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":17,"oldLines":7,"newStart":17,"newLines":7,"lines":[" _Avoid_: Post, blog, article"," "," **Slug**:","-The short, URL-safe name that identifies a Recap or Page in the public site's addresses, such as `chicago-food-crawl`. A Recap's Slug is unique within its Trip, and a Page's Slug is unique among Pages.","+The short, URL-safe name that identifies a Trip, Recap, or Page in the public site's addresses, such as `2026-chicago` or `chicago-food-crawl`. A Trip's Slug is unique among Trips, a Recap's within its Trip, and a Page's among Pages. A Page cannot take a Slug the site already uses, such as `trips` or `images`."," _Avoid_: Permalink, path, handle"," "," **Byline**:"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ab32bd3c-6b3e-40cb-b9bb-1d6f34bc641a","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3c83bfcc-3eab-41bd-893a-8b0e0abb030e","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

Only Admins create or edit Pages.","newString":"A Page has a title, a Slug, a text-only body, and a Draft or Published status. Only Admins create or edit Pages.","originalFile":"# Kenyon Model UN Recaps\n\nA content system where the Kenyon Model UN club's officers publish recaps of the club's conference trips for the Kenyon community.\n\n## Content\n\n**Trip**:\nOne conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Trip carries its own required Summary of what the trip was, and groups the Recaps written about it.\n_Avoid_: Event, conference (as the record's name)\n\n**Summary**:\nAn Admin-written overview on a Trip: the conference, where it was, and what happened overall. Readers see it at the top of the Trip's page.\n_Avoid_: Description, intro\n\n**Recap**:\nOne club member's personal account of exactly one Trip. A Recap has a title, a Slug, body text with optional Images, a Byline, and records of when it was created, last edited, and Published. It is written by an Editor, or entered by an Admin for a Contributor. Recaps are individual anecdotes, while the Trip's Summary says what the trip was. A Trip can have several Recaps.\n_Avoid_: Post, blog, article\n\n**Slug**:\nThe short, URL-safe name that identifies a Trip, Recap, or Page in the public site's addresses, such as `2026-chicago` or `chicago-food-crawl`. A Trip's Slug is unique among Trips, a Recap's within its Trip, and a Page's among Pages. A Page cannot take a Slug the site already uses, such as `trips` or `images`.\n_Avoid_: Permalink, path, handle\n\n**Byline**:\nThe writer's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required. An Editor's or Admin's Byline comes from their account, and an Admin types a Contributor's Byline by hand.\n_Avoid_: Author (an Admin who typed a Recap in is not its writer)\n\n**Image**:\nA photo uploaded to a Recap and placed inline in its body, always with alt text. Images belong to Recaps only. Recaps show only uploaded Images, never ones hosted elsewhere.\n_Avoid_: Media, attachment, embed\n\n**Page**:\nStanding content about the club that is not tied to a Trip, such as \"About the club\" or \"Officers and contact\". A Page has a title, a Slug, a body, and a Draft or Published status. Only Admins create or edit Pages.\n_Avoid_: Static page, post\n\n**Navigation bar**:\nThe list of links across the top of the public site, built from the Published Pages.\n_Avoid_: Menu, header links\n\n## Publishing\n\n**Draft**:\nA Recap's or Page's status while it is still being written. Every Recap and Page starts as a Draft, and Drafts never leave the database.\n\n**Submitted**:\nA Recap's status once its Editor says it is finished and ready for an Admin to review. Nobody but an Admin can change it from here.\n_Avoid_: Pending, in review\n\n**Published**:\nA Recap's or Page's status once an Admin has approved it for the public site. It is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\n\n**Submit**:\nAn Editor moving their own Recap from Draft to Submitted.\n\n**Send back**:\nAn Admin returning a Submitted Recap to Draft so its Editor can revise it.\n_Avoid_: Reject\n\n**Publish / Unpublish**:\nMoving a Recap or Page to Published, or from Published back to Draft. Only Admins Publish or Unpublish.\n_Avoid_: using \"publish\" for rebuilding the site\n\n**Deploy**:\nRebuilding the public site from every Published Recap and Page and pushing it live. Only Admins deploy. The assignment names the command `cms publish`. That command performs a Deploy, despite its name.\n_Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push\n\n**Backup**:\nA dated archive of the database and uploaded Images, kept somewhere private outside the repository. It is the only copy of Drafts and Recap sources if the Console laptop is lost. Only Admins make Backups.\n\n## Operations\n\n**Console laptop**:\nThe single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Admins work on it, and Editors log in on it during the Sunday club meetings.\n\n**Handover**:\nThe yearly transfer to new officers: outgoing Admins create the incoming Admins' accounts, incoming Admins remove the outgoing ones, and the Console laptop or latest Backup moves with them. The last Admin can never be removed.\n\n## People\n\n**Admin**:\nThe club's President or Vice President. Admins can do everything an Editor can, and also Publish and Unpublish, create Trips, create and edit Pages, manage accounts, Deploy, and make Backups. They can edit any Recap and enter one on a Contributor's behalf.\n_Avoid_: Officer (in the system), superuser\n\n**Editor**:\nA club member with their own account who writes their own Recaps as Drafts, adds Images with alt text to them, and Submits them. An Editor can edit or delete their own Recap only while it is a Draft. The President and VP decide which members become Editors, and an Admin creates the account. An Editor cannot Publish or Unpublish, create Trips, create or edit Pages, manage accounts, Deploy, make Backups, or edit another person's Recap.\n_Avoid_: Author, writer, contributor (for this role)\n\n**Contributor**:\nA member whose writing an Admin enters for them, for example because they missed a Sunday meeting and emailed it in. A Contributor has no account of their own.\n_Avoid_: Editor (for this role), author, writer\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":29,"oldLines":7,"newStart":29,"newLines":7,"lines":[" _Avoid_: Media, attachment, embed"," "," **Page**:","-Standing content about the club that is not tied to a Trip, such as \"About the club\" or \"Officers and contact\". A Page has a title, a Slug, a body, and a Draft or Published status. Only Admins create or edit Pages.","+Standing content about the club that is not tied to a Trip, such as \"About the club\" or \"Officers and contact\". A Page has a title, a Slug, a text-only body, and a Draft or Published status. Only Admins create or edit Pages."," _Avoid_: Static page, post"," "," **Navigation bar**:"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"c2fd5e0e-a897-4ded-9eee-7312036485cd","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3c83bfcc-3eab-41bd-893a-8b0e0abb030e","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"f12d9dcd-7f35-480b-bbf0-8f34e88fbf58","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"8098d23d-c1e0-445e-856c-7deb5eb538fe","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Dpmc4Rfc8jmgAhfW67QdWP","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t# Kenyon Model UN Recaps\n2\t\n3\tA content system where the Kenyon Model UN club's officers publish recaps of the club's conference trips for the Kenyon community.\n4\t\n5\t## Content\n6\t\n7\t**Trip**:\n8\tOne conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Trip carries its own required Summary of what the trip was, and groups the Recaps written about it.\n9\t_Avoid_: Event, conference (as the record's name)\n10\t\n11\t**Summary**:\n12\tAn Admin-written overview on a Trip: the conference, where it was, and what happened overall. Readers see it at the top of the Trip's page.\n13\t_Avoid_: Description, intro\n14\t\n15\t**Recap**:\n16\tOne club member's personal account of exactly one Trip. A Recap has a title, a Slug, body text with optional Images, a Byline, and records of when it was created, last edited, and Published. It is written by an Editor, or entered by an Admin for a Contributor. Recaps are individual anecdotes, while the Trip's Summary says what the trip was. A Trip can have several Recaps.\n17\t_Avoid_: Post, blog, article\n18\t\n19\t**Slug**:\n20\tThe short, URL-safe name that identifies a Trip, Recap, or Page in the public site's addresses, such as `2026-chicago` or `chicago-food-crawl`. A Trip's Slug is unique among Trips, a Recap's within its Trip, and a Page's among Pages. A Page cannot take a Slug the site already uses, such as `trips` or `images`.\n21\t_Avoid_: Permalink, path, handle\n22\t\n23\t**Byline**:\n24\tThe writer's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required. An Editor's or Admin's Byline comes from their account, and an Admin types a Contributor's Byline by hand.\n25\t_Avoid_: Author (an Admin who typed a Recap in is not its writer)\n26\t\n27\t**Image**:\n28\tA photo uploaded to a Recap and placed inline in its body, always with alt text. Images belong to Recaps only. Recaps show only uploaded Images, never ones hosted elsewhere.\n29\t_Avoid_: Media, attachment, embed\n30\t\n31\t**Page**:\n32\tStanding content about the club that is not tied to a Trip, such as \"About the club\" or \"Officers and contact\". A Page has a title, a Slug, a text-only body, and a Draft or Published status. Only Admins create or edit Pages.\n33\t_Avoid_: Static page, post\n34\t\n35\t**Navigation bar**:\n36\tThe list of links across the top of the public site: a Home link first, then the Published Pages in the order Admins set.\n37\t_Avoid_: Menu, header links\n38\t\n39\t## Publishing\n40\t\n41\t**Draft**:\n42\tA Recap's or Page's status while it is still being written. Every Recap and Page starts as a Draft, and Drafts never leave the database.\n43\t\n44\t**Submitted**:\n45\tA Recap's status once its Editor says it is finished and ready for an Admin to review. Nobody but an Admin can change it from here.\n46\t_Avoid_: Pending, in review\n47\t\n48\t**Published**:\n49\tA Recap's or Page's status once an Admin has approved it for the public site. It is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\n50\t\n51\t**Submit**:\n52\tAn Editor moving their own Recap from Draft to Submitted.\n53\t\n54\t**Send back**:\n55\tAn Admin returning a Submitted Recap to Draft so its Editor can revise it.\n56\t_Avoid_: Reject\n57\t\n58\t**Publish / Unpublish**:\n59\tMoving a Recap or Page to Published, or from Published back to Draft. Only Admins Publish or Unpublish.\n60\t_Avoid_: using \"publish\" for rebuilding the site\n61\t\n62\t**Deploy**:\n63\tRebuilding the public site from every Published Recap and Page and pushing it live. Only Admins deploy. The assignment names the command `cms publish`. That command performs a Deploy, despite its name.\n64\t_Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push\n65\t\n66\t**Backup**:\n67\tA dated archive of the database and uploaded Images, kept somewhere private outside the repository. It is the only copy of Drafts and Recap sources if the Console laptop is lost. Only Admins make Backups.\n68\t\n69\t## Operations\n70\t\n71\t**Console laptop**:\n72\tThe single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Admins work on it, and Editors log in on it during the Sunday club meetings.\n73\t\n74\t**Handover**:\n75\tThe yearly transfer to new officers: outgoing Admins create the incoming Admins' accounts, incoming Admins remove the outgoing ones, and the Console laptop or latest Backup moves with them. The last Admin can never be removed.\n76\t\n77\t## People\n78\t\n79\t**Admin**:\n80\tThe club's President or Vice President. Admins can do everything an Editor can, and also Publish and Unpublish, create Trips, create and edit Pages, manage accounts, Deploy, and make Backups. They can edit any Recap and enter one on a Contributor's behalf.\n81\t_Avoid_: Officer (in the system), superuser\n82\t\n83\t**Editor**:\n84\tA club member with their own account who writes their own Recaps as Drafts, adds Images with alt text to them, and Submits them. An Editor can edit or delete their own Recap only while it is a Draft. The President and VP decide which members become Editors, and an Admin creates the account. An Editor cannot Publish or Unpublish, create Trips, create or edit Pages, manage accounts, Deploy, make Backups, or edit another person's Recap.\n85\t_Avoid_: Author, writer, contributor (for this role)\n86\t\n87\t**Contributor**:\n88\tA member whose writing an Admin enters for them, for example because they missed a Sunday meeting and emailed it in. A Contributor has no account of their own.\n89\t_Avoid_: Editor (for this role), author, writer\n90\t"}]},"uuid":"ad55eb3d-07b1-403b-854a-1d5b8117cd6c","timestamp":"2026-10-24T14:25:09.545Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/CONTEXT.md","content":"# Kenyon Model UN Recaps\n\nA content system where the Kenyon Model UN club's officers publish recaps of the club's conference trips for the Kenyon community.\n\n## Content\n\n**Trip**:\nOne conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. {"parentUuid":"e78a9b18-9145-4c9f-820d-93b437e88e42","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMDTgETubvyEqvz2dGKZ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I checked the current `CONTEXT.md` (90 lines) against the seven capabilities. Three are fully covered, three only partly, and the admin console isn't covered at all. Two gaps need a decision from you. Note that `CONTEXT.md` is meant to be a glossary only, so some rules belong in the spec rather than here. `CLAUDE.md` already covers several of them: argon2 hashing, sanitizing, relative paths, and keeping Drafts out of `site/`.\n\n| # | Capability | `CONTEXT.md` terms that cover it | Gap |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 1 | **Login**: sign in and out, hashed passwords | **Editor** (\"their own account\"), **Console laptop** (\"log in on it\"), **Admin**, **Handover** | **Partial.** \"Account\" is used in four entries but never defined. Signing out is never mentioned. Hashing is rightly absent from the glossary, since `CLAUDE.md` has it, but the spec must state it. |\n| 2 | **Two roles** with genuinely different permissions | **Admin** and **Editor**, each with an explicit can and cannot list. **Submit** and **Send back** split the workflow between them. ADR-003 explains why. | **None.** |\n| 3 | **Posts** → **Recaps** and **Trips**: CRUD, title, slug, Markdown body, draft/published, author, timestamps | **Recap** (title, Slug, body, Byline, created, edited, and Published times), **Slug**, **Byline**, **Draft**, **Submitted**, **Published**, **Editor** (edits or deletes own Draft), **Admin** (edits any Recap, creates Trips), **Trip**, **Summary** | **Partial.**<br>• *Markdown* is never named. Recap says \"body text\".<br>• *Admins deleting any Recap* was settled earlier but isn't written down. Admin says \"edit any Recap\" only.<br>• *Author*: Byline is the name readers see, but there's no term for the account that **owns** a Recap, which is what \"own Recaps\" depends on. Who owns a Contributor's Recap is undefined.<br>• *Trip edit and delete*: only \"create Trips\" is stated. We agreed a Trip with Recaps can't be deleted, but that rule isn't recorded. |\n| 4 | **Pages**: same as posts, and published Pages appear in the nav | **Page** (title, Slug, text-only body, Draft or Published, Admin-only), **Navigation bar**, **Slug** (reserved names) | **Partial.** Pages have **no author and no timestamps**, which the capability requires because it says \"same as posts\". **Deleting** a Page isn't stated. **Markdown** isn't named here either. |\n| 5 | **Admin console**: dashboard with counts, filterable list, editor with preview | Only **Console laptop**, which says where the console runs, not what it contains | **Not covered.** Dashboard, counts and the filterable list are UI and belong in the spec. **Preview** was settled in round 4 (Preview button, rendered after a reload), and so was the \"still live until you Deploy\" warning. Neither is recorded anywhere, so both must go into the spec. |\n| 6 | **User management**: admin only, create users, change roles, deactivate, deactivated users can't log in | **Admin** (\"manage accounts\"), **Editor** (\"an Admin creates the account\"), **Handover** (create accounts, remove outgoing ones, last Admin can't be removed) | **Partial, with a conflict.** **Changing a role** isn't mentioned. **Deactivate** is absent, and Handover says *remove*, which is a different operation. Deleting an Editor would leave their Recaps with no owner. Deactivating keeps their Recaps and only blocks login. \"A deactivated user can't log in\" isn't stated anywhere. |\n| 7 | **Public site and publish**: only published content, sanitized Markdown, nav built from Pages, `cms publish` writes `site/` with relative paths | **Draft** (\"never leave the database\"), **Published**, **Deploy** (records the `cms publish` naming), **Navigation bar**, **Image** (no external images) | **Partial.** \"Public site\" is used but not defined. **Deploy** lists Recaps and Pages but leaves out Trips. The rule that a Trip appears only once it has a Published Recap isn't recorded. The ban on **external links** in Recap bodies isn't recorded either. Sanitizing and relative paths are correctly left to `CLAUDE.md` and the spec. |\n\n### Decisions needed before I can close these gaps\n\n1. **Deactivate or remove?** I recommend adding **Deactivate** as the term and changing Handover to say outgoing Admins are *deactivated*, not removed. Deactivated accounts can't log in, but their Recaps and Bylines stay. The last *active* Admin can't be deactivated. Changing a role would also become an Admin action.\n2. **Who owns a Recap?** I recommend that every Recap has an **owner** account: the Editor who wrote it, or the Admin who entered it for a Contributor. The Byline remains a separate thing, being the name readers see. Pages would get an owner and timestamps the same way.\n\nThe remaining gaps are wording fixes or things that belong in the spec. These are: Account, sign out, Markdown, deleting Recaps, Trips and Pages, the Trip visibility rule, the external-link ban, Trips in Deploy, and Preview with the \"still live\" warning. As you asked, I haven't edited or committed anything. Tell me how you want to decide the two questions above, and I'll make all the fixes in one pass."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2199,"cache_read_input_tokens":94958,"output_tokens":3392,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":1503},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2199,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":3392,"cache_read_input_tokens":94958,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2199,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2199},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"a2e78fb1-9ed7-46d3-84be-83d924ada9ea","apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011CgMDTfwbmhoQmhrxAzX7Z","requestRef":"43f96125-bc14-4686-87e1-f68ba221b0a9","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","type":"assistant","uuid":"3b89d5c7-65b1-439c-935d-c3959ef12d90","timestamp":"2026-10-24T14:25:42.385Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3c83bfcc-3eab-41bd-893a-8b0e0abb030e","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"6e0e6aa6-bbb9-46b8-af75-3d3469fcbc0d","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMDexLPqUsnUC8C8j3m8","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_017hvsS1VTxJHaXeJzKYmqFC","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/CONTEXT.md","content":"# Kenyon Model UN Recaps\n\nA content system where the Kenyon Model UN club's officers publish recaps of the club's conference trips for the Kenyon community.\n\n## Content\n\n**Trip**:\nOne conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Trip carries its own required Summary of what the trip was, and groups the Recaps written about it. A Trip appears on the Public site only once it has at least one Published Recap, and it can be deleted only while it has no Recaps.\n_Avoid_: Event, conference (as the record's name)\n\n**Summary**:\nAn Admin-written overview on a Trip: the conference, where it was, and what happened overall. Readers see it at the top of the Trip's page.\n_Avoid_: Description, intro\n\n**Recap**:\nOne club member's personal account of exactly one Trip. A Recap has a title, a Slug, a Markdown body with optional Images, a Byline, an Owner, and records of when it was created, last edited, and Published. It is written by an Editor, or entered by an Admin for a Contributor. Recaps are individual anecdotes, while the Trip's Summary says what the trip was. A Trip can have several Recaps.\n_Avoid_: Post, blog, article\n\n**Slug**:\nThe short, URL-safe name that identifies a Trip, Recap, or Page in the public site's addresses, such as `2026-chicago` or `chicago-food-crawl`. A Trip's Slug is unique among Trips, a Recap's within its Trip, and a Page's among Pages. A Page cannot take a Slug the site already uses, such as `trips` or `images`.\n_Avoid_: Permalink, path, handle\n\n**Byline**:\nThe writer's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required. An Editor's or Admin's Byline comes from their Account, and an Admin types a Contributor's Byline by hand. The Byline is separate from the Recap's Owner.\n_Avoid_: Author (an Admin who typed a Recap in is not its writer)\n\n**Owner**:\nThe Account a Recap or Page belongs to: the Editor who wrote it, or the Admin who created it or entered it for a Contributor. \"Their own Recap\" means a Recap they Own.\n_Avoid_: Author, creator\n\n**Image**:\nA photo uploaded to a Recap and placed inline in its body, always with alt text. Images belong to Recaps only. Recaps show only uploaded Images, never ones hosted elsewhere.\n_Avoid_: Media, attachment, embed\n\n**Page**:\nStanding content about the club that is not tied to a Trip, such as \"About the club\" or \"Officers and contact\". A Page has a title, a Slug, a text-only Markdown body, a Draft or Published status, an Owner, and records of when it was created and last edited. Only Admins create, edit, or delete Pages.\n_Avoid_: Static page, post\n\n**Body**:\nThe Markdown text of a Recap or Page. A Body never links to outside sites or shows images hosted elsewhere.\n_Avoid_: Content, text (for this field)\n\n**Navigation bar**:\nThe list of links across the top of the public site: a Home link first, then the Published Pages in the order Admins set.\n_Avoid_: Menu, header links\n\n## Publishing\n\n**Public site**:\nThe static website the Kenyon community reads: Trips that have a Published Recap, their Published Recaps, the Published Pages, and the Navigation bar. Deploy produces it. Nothing else reaches it.\n_Avoid_: Blog, front end, live site\n\n**Draft**:\nA Recap's or Page's status while it is still being written. Every Recap and Page starts as a Draft, and Drafts never leave the database.\n\n**Submitted**:\nA Recap's status once its Editor says it is finished and ready for an Admin to review. Nobody but an Admin can change it from here.\n_Avoid_: Pending, in review\n\n**Published**:\nA Recap's or Page's status once an Admin has approved it for the public site. It is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\n\n**Submit**:\nAn Editor moving their own Recap from Draft to Submitted.\n\n**Send back**:\nAn Admin returning a Submitted Recap to Draft so its Editor can revise it.\n_Avoid_: Reject\n\n**Publish / Unpublish**:\nMoving a Recap or Page to Published, or from Published back to Draft. Only Admins Publish or Unpublish.\n_Avoid_: using \"publish\" for rebuilding the site\n\n**Deploy**:\nRebuilding the Public site from the Trips, Published Recaps, and Published Pages, and pushing it live. Only Admins deploy. The assignment names the command `cms publish`. That command performs a Deploy, despite its name.\n_Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push\n\n**Backup**:\nA dated archive of the database and uploaded Images, kept somewhere private outside the repository. It is the only copy of Drafts and Recap sources if the Console laptop is lost. Only Admins make Backups.\n\n## Operations\n\n**Console laptop**:\nThe single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Admins work on it, and Editors log in on it during the Sunday club meetings.\n\n**Handover**:\nThe yearly transfer to new officers: outgoing Admins create the incoming Admins' Accounts, incoming Admins Deactivate the outgoing ones, and the Console laptop or latest Backup moves with them.\n\n## People\n\n**Account**:\nOne person's login to the admin console, carrying their name, class year, and role (Admin or Editor). An Account is either active or Deactivated.\n_Avoid_: User (in prose), profile, login\n\n**Deactivate**:\nAn Admin switching off an Account so it can no longer log in. Its Recaps, Pages, and Bylines stay as they are. The last active Admin can never be Deactivated.\n_Avoid_: Delete, remove, ban\n\n**Admin**:\nThe club's President or Vice President. Admins can do everything an Editor can, and also Publish and Unpublish, Send back, create, edit, and delete Trips, create, edit, and delete Pages, create Accounts, change an Account's role, Deactivate Accounts, Deploy, and make Backups. They can edit or delete any Recap and enter one on a Contributor's behalf.\n_Avoid_: Officer (in the system), superuser\n\n**Editor**:\nA club member with their own Account who writes their own Recaps as Drafts, adds Images with alt text to them, and Submits them. An Editor can edit or delete their own Recap only while it is a Draft. The President and VP decide which members become Editors, and an Admin creates the Account. An Editor cannot Publish or Unpublish, create Trips, create or edit Pages, manage Accounts, Deploy, make Backups, or edit another person's Recap.\n_Avoid_: Author, writer, contributor (for this role)\n\n**Contributor**:\nA member whose writing an Admin enters for them, for example because they missed a Sunday meeting and emailed it in. A Contributor has no Account of their own.\n_Avoid_: Editor (for this role), author, writer\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":415,"cache_read_input_tokens":100549,"output_tokens":3644,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":1170},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":415,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":3644,"cache_read_input_tokens":100549,"cache_creation_input_tokens":415,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":415},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_017hvsS1VTxJHaXeJzKYmqFC":{"file_path":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/CONTEXT.md","content":"# Kenyon Model UN Recaps\n\nA content system where the Kenyon Model UN club's officers publish recaps of the club's conference trips for the Kenyon community.\n\n## Content\n\n**Trip**:\nOne conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Body never links to outside sites or shows images hosted elsewhere.\n_Avoid_: Content, text (for this field)\n\n**Navigation bar**:\nThe list of links across the top of the public site: a Home link first, then the Published Pages in the order Admins set.\n_Avoid_: Menu, header links\n\n## Publishing\n\n**Public site**:\nThe static website the Kenyon community reads: Trips that have a Published Recap, their Published Recaps, the Published Pages, and the Navigation bar. Deploy produces it. Nothing else reaches it.\n_Avoid_: Blog, front end, live site\n\n**Draft**:\nA Recap's or Page's status while it is still being written. Every Recap and Page starts as a Draft, and Drafts never leave the database.\n\n**Submitted**:\nA Recap's status once its Editor says it is finished and ready for an Admin to review. Nobody but an Admin can change it from here.\n_Avoid_: Pending, in review\n\n**Published**:\nA Recap's or Page's status once an Admin has approved it for the public site. It is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\n\n**Submit**:\nAn Editor moving their own Recap from Draft to Submitted.\n\n**Send back**:\nAn Admin returning a Submitted Recap to Draft so its Editor can revise it.\n_Avoid_: Reject\n\n**Publish / Unpublish**:\nMoving a Recap or Page to Published, or from Published back to Draft. Only Admins Publish or Unpublish.\n_Avoid_: using \"publish\" for rebuilding the site\n\n**Deploy**:\nRebuilding the Public site from the Trips, Published Recaps, and Published Pages, and pushing it live. Only Admins deploy. The assignment names the command `cms publish`. That command performs a Deploy, despite its name.\n_Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push\n\n**Backup**:\nA dated archive of the database and uploaded Images, kept somewhere private outside the repository. It is the only copy of Drafts and Recap sources if the Console laptop is lost. Only Admins make Backups.\n\n## Operations\n\n**Console laptop**:\nThe single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Admins work on it, and Editors log in on it during the Sunday club meetings.\n\n**Handover**:\nThe yearly transfer to new officers: outgoing Admins create the incoming Admins' Accounts, incoming Admins Deactivate the outgoing ones, and the Console laptop or latest Backup moves with them.\n\n## People\n\n**Account**:\nOne person's login to the admin console, carrying their name, class year, and role (Admin or Editor). An Account is either active or Deactivated.\n_Avoid_: User (in prose), profile, login\n\n**Deactivate**:\nAn Admin switching off an Account so it can no longer log in. Its Recaps, Pages, and Bylines stay as they are. The last active Admin can never be Deactivated.\n_Avoid_: Delete, remove, ban\n\n**Admin**:\nThe club's President or Vice President. Admins can do everything an Editor can, and also Publish and Unpublish, Send back, create, edit, and delete Trips, create, edit, and delete Pages, create Accounts, change an Account's role, Deactivate Accounts, Deploy, and make Backups. They can edit or delete any Recap and enter one on a Contributor's behalf.\n_Avoid_: Officer (in the system), superuser\n\n**Editor**:\nA club member with their own Account who writes their own Recaps as Drafts, adds Images with alt text to them, and Submits them. An Editor can edit or delete their own Recap only while it is a Draft. The President and VP decide which members become Editors, and an Admin creates the Account. An Editor cannot Publish or Unpublish, create Trips, create or edit Pages, manage Accounts, Deploy, make Backups, or edit another person's Recap.\n_Avoid_: Author, writer, contributor (for this role)\n\n**Contributor**:\nA member whose writing an Admin enters for them, for example because they missed a Sunday meeting and emailed it in. A Contributor has no Account of their own.\n_Avoid_: Editor (for this role), author, writer\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":5,"oldLines":7,"newStart":5,"newLines":7,"lines":[" ## Content"," "," **Trip**:","-One conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Contributor has no Account of their own."," _Avoid_: Editor (for this role), author, writer"]}],"originalFile":"# Kenyon Model UN Recaps\n\nA content system where the Kenyon Model UN club's officers publish recaps of the club's conference trips for the Kenyon community.\n\n## Content\n\n**Trip**:\nOne conference journey the club made, such as the Chicago conference. A Trip carries its own required Summary of what the trip was, and groups the Recaps written about it.\n_Avoid_: Event, conference (as the record's name)\n\n**Summary**:\nAn Admin-written overview on a Trip: the conference, where it was, and what happened overall. Readers see it at the top of the Trip's page.\n_Avoid_: Description, intro\n\n**Recap**:\nOne club member's personal account of exactly one Trip. A Recap has a title, a Slug, body text with optional Images, a Byline, and records of when it was created, last edited, and Published. It is written by an Editor, or entered by an Admin for a Contributor. Recaps are individual anecdotes, while the Trip's Summary says what the trip was. A Trip can have several Recaps.\n_Avoid_: Post, blog, article\n\n**Slug**:\nThe short, URL-safe name that identifies a Trip, Recap, or Page in the public site's addresses, such as `2026-chicago` or `chicago-food-crawl`. A Trip's Slug is unique among Trips, a Recap's within its Trip, and a Page's among Pages. A Page cannot take a Slug the site already uses, such as `trips` or `images`.\n_Avoid_: Permalink, path, handle\n\n**Byline**:\nThe writer's name and class year shown on a Recap, such as \"by Jane Doe '27\". Both parts are required. An Editor's or Admin's Byline comes from their account, and an Admin types a Contributor's Byline by hand.\n_Avoid_: Author (an Admin who typed a Recap in is not its writer)\n\n**Image**:\nA photo uploaded to a Recap and placed inline in its body, always with alt text. Images belong to Recaps only. Recaps show only uploaded Images, never ones hosted elsewhere.\n_Avoid_: Media, attachment, embed\n\n**Page**:\nStanding content about the club that is not tied to a Trip, such as \"About the club\" or \"Officers and contact\". A Page has a title, a Slug, a text-only body, and a Draft or Published status. Only Admins create or edit Pages.\n_Avoid_: Static page, post\n\n**Navigation bar**:\nThe list of links across the top of the public site: a Home link first, then the Published Pages in the order Admins set.\n_Avoid_: Menu, header links\n\n## Publishing\n\n**Draft**:\nA Recap's or Page's status while it is still being written. Every Recap and Page starts as a Draft, and Drafts never leave the database.\n\n**Submitted**:\nA Recap's status once its Editor says it is finished and ready for an Admin to review. Nobody but an Admin can change it from here.\n_Avoid_: Pending, in review\n\n**Published**:\nA Recap's or Page's status once an Admin has approved it for the public site. It is not visible to readers until the next Deploy.\n\n**Submit**:\nAn Editor moving their own Recap from Draft to Submitted.\n\n**Send back**:\nAn Admin returning a Submitted Recap to Draft so its Editor can revise it.\n_Avoid_: Reject\n\n**Publish / Unpublish**:\nMoving a Recap or Page to Published, or from Published back to Draft. Only Admins Publish or Unpublish.\n_Avoid_: using \"publish\" for rebuilding the site\n\n**Deploy**:\nRebuilding the public site from every Published Recap and Page and pushing it live. Only Admins deploy. The assignment names the command `cms publish`. That command performs a Deploy, despite its name.\n_Avoid_: Publish (for this action), build, push\n\n**Backup**:\nA dated archive of the database and uploaded Images, kept somewhere private outside the repository. It is the only copy of Drafts and Recap sources if the Console laptop is lost. Only Admins make Backups.\n\n## Operations\n\n**Console laptop**:\nThe single machine (the President's) that runs the admin console and holds the one real database. Admins work on it, and Editors log in on it during the Sunday club meetings.\n\n**Handover**:\nThe yearly transfer to new officers: outgoing Admins create the incoming Admins' accounts, incoming Admins remove the outgoing ones, and the Console laptop or latest Backup moves with them. The last Admin can never be removed.\n\n## People\n\n**Admin**:\nThe club's President or Vice President. Admins can do everything an Editor can, and also Publish and Unpublish, create Trips, create and edit Pages, manage accounts, Deploy, and make Backups. They can edit any Recap and enter one on a Contributor's behalf.\n_Avoid_: Officer (in the system), superuser\n\n**Editor**:\nA club member with their own account who writes their own Recaps as Drafts, adds Images with alt text to them, and Submits them. An Editor can edit or delete their own Recap only while it is a Draft. The President and VP decide which members become Editors, and an Admin creates the account. An Editor cannot Publish or Unpublish, create Trips, create or edit Pages, manage accounts, Deploy, make Backups, or edit another person's Recap.\n_Avoid_: Author, writer, contributor (for this role)\n\n**Contributor**:\nA member whose writing an Admin enters for them, for example because they missed a Sunday meeting and emailed it in. A Contributor has no account of their own.\n_Avoid_: Editor (for this role), author, writer\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"05b08f87-afc2-45f5-8702-9162d4fe916a","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3c83bfcc-3eab-41bd-893a-8b0e0abb030e","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"ed275352-049b-495d-9cae-41a174b124be","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMDhBQW2hBAWxXhpwjPq","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"`CONTEXT.md` now has all the changes in one pass. Nothing is committed.\n\nI read \"edit or delete a Trip only if it has no Recaps\" as: Admins can **edit** any Trip, but can only **delete** a Trip that has no Recaps. That matches what we settled in round 4. The literal reading would also block edits, which would mean a typo in a Trip's Summary could never be fixed once a Recap exists. If you did mean edits should be blocked too, tell me and I'll change it.\n\n## Changed terms\n\n**New terms**\n- **Owner**: \"The Account a Recap or Page belongs to: the Editor who wrote it, or the Admin who created it or entered it for a Contributor. 'Their own Recap' means a Recap they Own.\" _Avoid_: Author, creator.\n- **Body**: \"The Markdown text of a Recap or Page. A Body never links to outside sites or shows images hosted elsewhere.\"\n- **Public site**: \"The static website the Kenyon community reads: Trips that have a Published Recap, their Published Recaps, the Published Pages, and the Navigation bar. Deploy produces it. Nothing else reaches it.\"\n- **Account**: \"One person's login to the admin console, carrying their name, class year, and role (Admin or Editor). An Account is either active or Deactivated.\" _Avoid_: User (in prose), profile, login.\n- **Deactivate**: \"An Admin switching off an Account so it can no longer log in. Its Recaps, Pages, and Bylines stay as they are. The last active Admin can never be Deactivated.\" _Avoid_: Delete, remove, ban.\n\n**Changed terms**\n- **Trip**: added \"appears on the Public site only once it has at least one Published Recap, and it can be deleted only while it has no Recaps.\"\n- **Recap**: now has \"a **Markdown** body … a Byline, an **Owner**, and records of when it was created, last edited, and Published.\"\n- **Byline**: added \"The Byline is separate from the Recap's Owner.\" It also now says \"Account\" where it said \"account\".\n- **Page**: now has \"a text-only **Markdown** body … an **Owner**, and records of when it was created and last edited.\" Admins can now also **delete** Pages.\n- **Deploy**: now \"from the **Trips**, Published Recaps, and Published Pages.\"\n- **Handover**: incoming Admins now **Deactivate** the outgoing ones instead of removing them. I took out its \"last Admin\" sentence, because **Deactivate** now carries that rule.\n- **Admin**: added Send back, create, edit, and delete Trips and Pages, create Accounts, **change an Account's role**, **Deactivate** Accounts, and **edit or delete any Recap**.\n- **Editor** and **Contributor**: \"account\" became \"Account\" to match the new term.\n\nThe ban on external links now sits in **Body**, so it covers Pages as well as Recaps. That means an \"Officers and contact\" Page can't link to an outside site. If you want contact emails on that Page, we'll need to make an exception for them.\n\n## For /to-spec: settled in chat but kept out of CONTEXT.md\n\n**Admin console UI**\n- A dashboard with counts.\n- A content list you can filter, with Submitted Recaps shown first to Admins.\n- A **Preview** button that shows the sanitized rendering after a reload. There's no live preview.\n- The warning \"still live until you Deploy\" when an Admin edits or Unpublishes a Published Recap.\n- **Sign out**.\n- After an Image is uploaded, the console shows a Markdown snippet with the alt text filled in, ready to paste.\n- Each Page has a number an Admin sets, which decides its position in the Navigation bar.\n- An Editor's Byline is filled in automatically from their Account.\n\n**Content rules**\n- A Trip's fields are conference name, host city, start date, end date, and Summary. Its default Slug is the year plus the city.\n- Images can be JPEG, PNG, or WebP, up to about 5 MB each.\n- The reserved Slugs are at least `trips` and `images`.\n\n**Public site**\n- The home page lists Trips newest first.\n- A Trip page shows its Summary, then its Recaps in the order they were Published.\n- Addresses look like `trips/<trip>/<recap>/` and `<page>/`, all relative.\n- The footer has one link to the club's Instagram.\n\n**Commands**\n- `cms backup` makes a dated archive, which is never committed to git.\n- `cms publish` keeps its name because the assignment requires it.\n\n**Out of scope or known gaps**\n- Comments.\n- Images on Pages, as a possible later addition.\n- Editing from outside the Console laptop (ADR-003).\n\nSay go and I'll commit `CONTEXT.md` and `docs/adr/ADR-003-editors-at-sunday-meetings.md`."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3731,"cache_read_input_tokens":100964,"output_tokens":1877,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":266},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3731,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1877,"cache_read_input_tokens":100964,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3731,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3731},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"9c91bfa6-87ef-44d4-83c4-0f47d1bfcdb3","apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011CgMDhB4fShr99FfNW4d3N","requestRef":"e5f35d29-b6e2-4289-90fd-c3abd832fc21","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","type":"assistant","uuid":"a680e6ab-65a2-4d8d-9c95-93a3a6a03122","timestamp":"2026-10-24T14:28:28.994Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3c83bfcc-3eab-41bd-893a-8b0e0abb030e","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"main"}

Each user story should be in the format of:\n\n1. As an <actor>, I want a <feature>, so that <benefit>\n\n<user-story-example>\n1. As a mobile bank customer, I want to see balance on my accounts, so that I can make better informed decisions about my spending\n</user-story-example>\n\nThis list of user stories should be extremely extensive and cover all aspects of the feature.\n\n## Implementation Decisions\n\nA list of implementation decisions that were made. This can include:\n\n- The modules that will be built/modified\n- The interfaces of those modules that will be modified\n- Technical clarifications from the developer\n- Architectural decisions\n- Schema changes\n- API contracts\n- Specific interactions\n\nDo NOT include specific file paths or code snippets. They may end up being outdated very quickly.\n\nException: if a prototype produced a snippet that encodes a decision more precisely than prose can (state machine, reducer, schema, type shape), inline it within the relevant decision and note briefly that it came from a prototype. Trim to the decision-rich parts, not a working demo, just the important bits.\n\n## Testing Decisions\n\nA list of testing decisions that were made. Include:\n\n- A description of what makes a good test (only test external behavior, not implementation details)\n- Which modules will be tested\n- Prior art for the tests (i.e. similar types of tests in the codebase)\n\n## Out of Scope\n\nA description of the things that are out of scope for this spec.\n\n## Further Notes\n\nAny further notes about the feature.\n\n</spec-template>\n\n\nARGUMENTS: Use CONTEXT.md, ADR-001..003, and the settled UI/other details list from this session.
