{"parentUuid":"e56abef8-9874-4f6e-b33d-57fb79e4d9cf","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgMELi7VqsJeMSQYwE8a3","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I published the spec as **[issue #1](https://github.com/andrew-vera26/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/1)**, labelled `spec`, and the phase file is set to `spec`.\n\n**Git**\n- `grill/kenyon-mun-domain` was fast-forwarded into `main` and pushed (`54dfbfe`). The branch only ever existed locally, so I deleted it there.\n- The `CONTEXT.md` fix is committed as `06d4fd9` on a new local branch, `spec/kenyon-mun`, not on `main`, and not pushed. The fix: a Deploy is `cms publish` (render) followed by `cms deploy` (push).\n- The transcripts, the ledger and the research note are untouched and uncommitted.\n\n**What the spec contains**\n- 67 user stories, with a table at the end mapping each of the seven capabilities to the stories, decisions and tests that cover it.\n- **Capability 5:**\n  - Dashboard counts per role, plus a \"changes not yet live\" notice.\n  - A Recap list filterable by status, Trip and Owner, with Submitted Recaps first.\n  - A Preview button on both editors that uses the same sanitizer as `cms publish`.\n- **Required tests:**\n  - An anonymous visitor is redirected to login.\n  - An Editor gets a 403 or a redirect on every route in the Admin-only list.\n  - An Editor can't Publish or Unpublish, or edit, Submit or delete someone else's Recap.\n  - Passwords are stored as argon2 hashes.\n  - Every form carries a CSRF token, and a POST without one gets a 403.\n  - Markdown is sanitized in both Preview and `site/`.\n- **Test seams:** only the HTTP app (with `client_as`) and `render_site(out)`. `cms backup` is tested through the existing `main(argv)`. Nothing new is added.\n- Deploy and Backup are terminal-only, which was your choice 2(a).\n\n**Decisions I made that you haven't confirmed**\n- Reactivating a Deactivated Account is left out. It's flagged in Further Notes.\n- Password reset by email is left out. An Admin sets a new password instead.\n- Editors see only their own Recaps in the list.\n- The Byline is copied onto a Recap when it's created, so later Account changes don't rewrite it.\n- Reserved Page Slugs also include `admin` and `login`.\n- The Instagram link comes from an environment setting.\n\nIf you want any of these changed, I'll edit the issue.\n\nThe context-guard hook reports context at 30%, with a 40% hard limit. Before ticketing, it's worth running `/handoff` or `/compact`."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":761,"cache_read_input_tokens":132213,"output_tokens":1005,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":112},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":761,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1005,"cache_read_input_tokens":132213,"cache_creation_input_tokens":761,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":761},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"6a52555e-4976-4eda-87a9-e4aaea3aff1d","apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011CgMELhNb73PkMWkugGp9d","requestRef":"13556824-9ef0-4072-aaec-611e0c4a4d32","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","type":"assistant","uuid":"c9a6a815-9cd4-438a-85ed-c57215d57295","timestamp":"2026-10-24T14:36:50.967Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"9dbdcd61-9843-4f89-8b21-3507a429536c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/andrewv/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3c83bfcc-3eab-41bd-893a-8b0e0abb030e","version":"2.1.309","gitBranch":"spec/kenyon-mun"}

The President and Vice President want a place where members' Recaps of each Trip (where the team went, how the competition went, what they explored and ate) are published with photos and stay findable. Members need to be able to write their own Recaps. The officers must stay in control of what reaches readers, and no member can ever change another member's work or touch accounts.\n12:- A static **Public site** that an Admin Deploys from the terminal. It lists Trips newest first. Each Trip page shows its Summary and then its Published Recaps. Admin-written Pages, such as \"About the club\", form the Navigation bar. A footer link sends readers to Instagram for discussion. Only Published content reaches the Public site, and all of it is sanitized.\n102:59. As a reader, I want a footer link to the club's Instagram for discussion, so that I can react to a Recap even though the site has no comments.\n180:Addresses take the forms `trips/<trip>/`, `trips/<trip>/<recap>/` and `<page>/`, each as an index file. Every link is computed relative to the page's depth. The Navigation bar is Home followed by the Published Pages by nav position. The footer holds the Instagram link, read from a setting in the environment. Nothing that isn't Published is ever read by the renderer.\n226:- Comments on the Public site. The next session turns spec issue #1 into vertical-slice ticket issues (T01, T02, …) ready for implementation.\n\n## Done (this session)\n- Ran `/grill-with-docs`. `CONTEXT.md` now holds the full glossary (54dfbfe, plus the Deploy wording fix in 06d4fd9).\n- Wrote `docs/adr/ADR-003-editors-at-sunday-meetings.md`: Editors exist, only Admins Publish, Editors use the Console laptop at the Sunday meetings, and remote editing is out of scope.\n- Published the spec as https://github.com/andrew-vera26/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/1, labelled `spec` (deliberately not `ready-for-agent`). It covers 67 user stories, a table mapping stories to the seven capabilities, the test seams, and the required tests.\n- Edited issue #1 so the Instagram footer URL is a committed constant, not an environment variable. The placeholder is `https://www.instagram.com/REPLACE-ME/`.\n- Pushed `main` to origin. No feature branches remain.\n\n## In progress (state on disk right now)\n- Nothing is half-built, and no app code has changed since T00.\n- The user said to leave these uncommitted until they decide: `notes/usage-ledger.csv` (modified), `notes/cms-content-model-research.md`, and `docs/transcripts/*session_06..09*.md` (untracked).\n- `.claude/state/phase` currently says `spec`.\n\n## Next steps (ordered, concrete, each startable in <1 min)\n1. Write `tickets` into `.claude/state/phase`.\n2. Read issue #1 (`gh issue view 1`), `CONTEXT.md`, and the ADRs in `docs/adr/`.\n3. Split #1 into vertical-slice ticket issues labelled `ticket`, each with acceptance tests drawn from #1's Testing Decisions. A sensible order: login, sessions and CSRF; Accounts and roles policy; Trips; Recaps and the status machine; Images; Pages and the Navigation bar; console dashboard, list and Preview; `render_site` for the Public site; `cms backup`; seed script. Confirm the breakdown with the user before creating issues.\n4. Later, per ticket: write the ticket id into the phase file. Before the closing commit, post the `/code-review` findings on the issue. Commit message starts `T0N:` and ends `Closes #N`.\n\n## Decisions and why (things a fresh session must not re-litigate)\n- Editors exist with their own Accounts, but only Admins Publish. The assignment requires two roles, and the officers want to review every Recap first. ADR-003 records this. An earlier \"admins only, no editor accounts\" version was rejected.\n- Deploy and Backup run from the terminal only, with no console buttons. The President owns the terminal, and pushing git from a web request adds failure modes.\n- Tests use only the existing seams: the HTTP app with `client`/`client_as`, `render_site(out)`, and the CLI `main(argv)`. The user asked for no new seams.\n- The Instagram URL is a committed constant so that `cms publish` is reproducible on any machine. The user will replace the placeholder before the final publish.\n- The ban on external links applies to every Body, Pages included.\n- Images belong to Recaps only. Pages are text-only, to keep the upload code to one kind of owner.\n\n## Gotchas / traps discovered\n- `cms publish` only renders `site/`, and `cms deploy` pushes it (see `app/cli.py`). The first glossary draft wrongly said `cms publish` pushes. That is now fixed.\n- The project `CLAUDE.md` says transcripts live in `transcripts/`, but this assignment keeps them in `docs/transcripts/`. Don't move them, and leave any stray files in `transcripts/` alone.\n- The user wants feature branches fast-forwarded into `main` and pushed, with the branch deleted afterwards.\n- `tests/conftest.py` `client_as` logs in at `/login` with email and password. The login route must match that.\n\n## Verification state\n- Tests: the T00 suite was not run this session. No code changed.\n\n## Pointers (read these before anything else)\n- https://github.com/andrew-vera26/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/1 — the spec, the source of truth for tickets\n- `CONTEXT.md` — the glossary. Use its terms, such as Recap rather than \"post\".\n- `docs/adr/ADR-001…003` — local console with a static site, the stack, and the Editors decision\n- `docs/manual_iphs400_mp2-web-cms_20260922.md` §3.3 — the seven required capabilities\n- `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_t00.py` — existing fixtures and prior art for tests\n\n## Open questions / risks\n- Issue #1 contains choices the user hasn't confirmed: no reactivating Accounts, no password reset by email, Editors see only their own Recaps, the Byline is copied onto a Recap when it is created, and reserved Page Slugs include `admin` and `login`. Raise them with the user before ticketing.\n- An \"Officers and contact\" Page can't include outside links because of the Body ban. Ask if contact emails are needed.\n\n## Suggested skills\n- `to-tickets`, if installed, to split issue #1 into tickets. No feature branches remain.\n\n## In progress (state on disk right now)\n- Nothing is half-built, and no app code has changed since T00.\n- The user said to leave these uncommitted until they decide: `notes/usage-ledger.csv` (modified), `notes/cms-content-model-research.md`, and `docs/transcripts/*session_06..09*.md` (untracked).\n- `.claude/state/phase` currently says `spec`.\n\n## Next steps (ordered, concrete, each startable in <1 min)\n1. Write `tickets` into `.claude/state/phase`.\n2. Read issue #1 (`gh issue view 1`), `CONTEXT.md`, and the ADRs in `docs/adr/`.\n3. Split #1 into vertical-slice ticket issues labelled `ticket`, each with acceptance tests drawn from #1's Testing Decisions. Confirm the breakdown with the user before creating issues.\n4. Later, per ticket: write the ticket id into the phase file. Before the closing commit, post the `/code-review` findings on the issue. Commit message starts `T0N:` and ends `Closes #N`.\n\n## Decisions and why (things a fresh session must not re-litigate)\n- Editors exist with their own Accounts, but only Admins Publish. The assignment requires two roles, and the officers want to review every Recap first. ADR-003 records this. An earlier \"admins only, no editor accounts\" version was rejected.\n- Deploy and Backup run from the terminal only, with no console buttons. The President owns the terminal, and pushing git from a web request adds failure modes.\n- Tests use only the existing seams: the HTTP app with `client`/`client_as`, `render_site(out)`, and the CLI `main(argv)`. The user will replace the placeholder before the final publish.\n- The ban on external links applies to every Body, Pages included.\n- Images belong to Recaps only. Pages are text-only, to keep the upload code to one kind of owner.\n\n## Gotchas / traps discovered\n- `cms publish` only renders `site/`, and `cms deploy` pushes it (see `app/cli.py`). The first glossary draft wrongly said `cms publish` pushes. That is now fixed.\n- The project `CLAUDE.md` says transcripts live in `transcripts/`, but this assignment keeps them in `docs/transcripts/`.
